items.name: Abate Fetel Pears
items.desc: abate fetel pears are large and elongated with a distinctive long, tapering neck and a wide, rounded base, resembling a bell or flask. their skin is typically yellowish-green, often with a russet-brown blush or patches, especially around the stem. the flesh is white, very sweet, juicy, and aromatic, offering a distinct visual and textural profile among pears.

items.name: Acorn Squash
items.desc: showing dark green deeply ridged acorn shape, orange patch, hard winter squash

items.name: Adora Seedless Grapes
items.desc: a bunch of adora seedless grapes hanging from a stem — a moderately loose cluster of notably large, exceptionally plump, round to slightly oblong berries with deep, glossy black skin. each berry has a characteristic small dimple at the blossom end. the bunch shows many individual berries attached to a main stem.

items.name: Akane Apples - Large
items.desc: akane apples are large, round, and have a vibrant, glossy red skin often with faint white lenticels. their flesh is crisp and bright white. this is the larger size variant for akane apples.

items.name: Akane Apples - Small
items.desc: akane apples are small, round, and have a vibrant, glossy red skin often with faint white lenticels. their flesh is crisp and bright white. this is the smaller size variant for akane apples.

items.name: Alfalfa Sprouts
items.desc: alfalfa sprouts are delicate, thread-like strands, typically light green to pale yellow in color. they feature tiny, clover-like leaves at the ends of thin stems, often sold in a tangled mass. the texture is very fine and crisp.

items.name: Alkmene Apples
items.desc: these are small to medium-sized, round-conical apples. their skin is a bright golden-yellow, predominantly covered with a vibrant orange-red flush and distinct red stripes. the flesh is creamy-white, crisp, and very juicy.

items.name: Aloe Vera Leaves
items.desc: aloe vera leaves are thick, fleshy, and spear-shaped, typically 1 to 2 feet long, with a waxy, matte green skin. they have serrated edges with small, soft spines and are filled with a clear, gelatinous pulp. their succulent appearance and rigid, elongated structure make them easily identifiable.

items.name: Amaranth Leaves
items.desc: vibrant green, sometimes with purplish-red veins or blotches, ovate to diamond-shaped leaves that can vary in size from small to quite large. the texture is tender when young, becoming slightly coarser when mature, offering an earthy flavor distinct from common spinach.

items.name: Ambrosia Apples
items.desc: showing pinkish-red blush over cream-yellow, tall shape, honey-like bi-color, very smooth skin, stem at the top, upright orientation

items.name: Ambrosia Apples - Small
items.desc: a small, conic to round apple with a bright, glossy bi-color skin, predominantly yellow with a vibrant pink-red blush. it has crisp, juicy white flesh and is noticeably smaller than a standard apple.

items.name: American Persimmon - Regular
items.desc: american persimmons are small, round to oval fruits, typically 1-2 inches in diameter, with a vibrant orange skin when ripe. they often have a distinctive leafy calyx on top. the flesh is very soft, custardy, and intensely sweet with a unique flavor, sometimes containing a few large seeds.

items.name: Anaheim Pepper
items.desc: long 6-8 inch pepper, light green, narrow tapered shape, smooth skin

items.name: Anise
items.desc: a single fennel bulb (sold as anise in produce) — a compact, rounded white-to-pale-green layered bulb about 3-4 inches wide at the base, with overlapping layers like an onion. short green stalks extend about 3-4 inches from the top, with wispy feathery green fronds at the tips. the base is trimmed flat with a small root nub.

items.name: Anjou Pears - Red
items.desc: red anjou pears are characterized by their squat, egg-shaped or ovoid form, lacking the distinct neck seen in bartlett or bosc varieties. the skin is remarkably smooth and boasts a bright crimson or deep burgundy color, sometimes with subtle green undertones. its flesh remains firm and juicy even when ripe, offering a mild, subtly sweet flavor.

items.name: Anjou Pears, Large
items.desc: showing egg-shaped short-necked pear, green skin, squat round shape

items.name: Anjou Pears, Small
items.desc: showing egg-shaped short-necked pear, green skin, squat round shape

items.name: Apple Bananas (Manzano)
items.desc: showing small chubby yellow banana, shorter than standard variety

items.name: Apples - Antares
items.desc: this is a medium to large, round apple with an intense, uniform dark red skin, often with subtle streaking. the skin is smooth and firm. it offers a very crisp texture and a juicy, balanced sweet flavor with a slight tang.

items.name: Apples - Baldwin
items.desc: baldwin apples are characterized by their red skin with streaks of carmine over a yellow-green background, often appearing mottled. they are medium to large in size, round to slightly conical, and have a smooth, tough skin. the flesh is yellowish, crisp, and possesses a sweet-tart flavor.

items.name: Apples - Dalinette
items.desc: dalinette apples are medium-sized and round, featuring a glossy, vibrant dark red skin that often displays subtle striping over a greenish-yellow base. the skin is smooth, and the fruit is notably firm with a crisp texture. it possesses a classic apple shape, often slightly wider at the bottom.

items.name: Apples - Evelina
items.desc: a medium-sized, round-conical apple with a vibrant, glossy red skin often streaked over a yellow-green background. it is known for its firm, crisp texture and a balanced sweet-tart flavor with a hint of honey. the skin may show small, pale lenticels.

items.name: Apples - Greening (RI)
items.desc: rhode island greening apple, bright to yellowish-green color with possible faint sun-blush, large round to slightly flattened shape, smooth firm skin, whole uncut single fruit, absolutely no shadow beneath or around the fruit, no cast shadow on background whatsoever, produce floating in empty space

items.name: Apples - Liberty
items.desc: liberty apples are medium-sized, round, and covered almost entirely by a deep, dark red blush over a yellowish-green base, sometimes with faint stripes. the skin is smooth and relatively thin. its firm, white flesh is crisp, very juicy, and has a balanced sweet-tart flavor, suitable for eating fresh or cooking.

items.name: Apples - Macoun
items.desc: macoun apples are typically a deep red to purple-red color with occasional green blush. they are round to slightly conical in shape, medium-sized, and have a somewhat dull, slightly rough skin texture with prominent lenticels. known for their aromatic, crisp, and juicy white flesh.

items.name: Apples - Melrose
items.desc: melrose apples are large, somewhat flattened, and have a dull red blush over a yellow-green background, often with subtle red stripes. the skin is thick and tough, sometimes with a slight russeting. its creamy white flesh is firm, juicy, and has a rich, slightly tart flavor, making it excellent for baking and eating.

items.name: Apples - Northern Spy
items.desc: northern spy apples are large, round to conical, and often have a bright red blush or stripes over a pale green to yellow background. the skin is thin, smooth, and easily bruised. they are known for their exceptionally juicy, crisp, and aromatic white flesh with a distinct sweet-tart flavor, often used for pies and sauces.

items.name: Apples - Orléans
items.desc: this is a medium-sized, somewhat conical apple with a bright crimson red skin, often streaked with lighter blush over a yellowish-green background. the skin is smooth and slightly waxy. it has a crisp texture and a sweet-tart flavor profile.

items.name: Apples - Rosinette
items.desc: this is a small to medium-sized, round-conical apple with a vibrant, rosy-red blush covering most of its pale yellow-green skin. it has a smooth, slightly glossy appearance. the flesh is firm and juicy, offering a balanced sweet-tart taste.

items.name: Apples - Scilate (ENVY) - Small
items.desc: small, round to conic-shaped apples with a striking deep ruby red skin, often with subtle yellow-green undertones around the stem or base. the skin is smooth and relatively thick, with a glossy finish. this specific size is noticeably smaller than a typical envy apple, easily fitting in the palm of a hand.

items.name: Apples - Sommerfeld
items.desc: medium-sized, roundish apple with a greenish-yellow base color largely covered by broad red stripes and washes. the skin can be slightly waxy, and the flesh is firm, juicy, and sweet with a refreshing hint of tartness.

items.name: Apples - SugarBee™
items.desc: sugarbee™ apples are typically large, round to slightly conical, distinguished by a vibrant coral-red blush and striping over a yellow background. the skin is smooth and firm, encasing exceptionally crisp and juicy flesh. they often have a somewhat irregular, slightly angular shape.

items.name: Apples - Virginia Gold
items.desc: medium to large, roundish-conical apple with smooth, thin, golden-yellow skin that sometimes develops a faint orange blush. the flesh is crisp, very juicy, and aromatic with a balanced sweet-tart flavor.

items.name: Apples - Wurtwinning (Bloss®)
items.desc: this is a medium-sized, round-conical apple with a bright, uniform red blush often covering a significant portion of its yellow-green background. the skin is smooth and firm. it has a crisp bite and a refreshing, sweet-tart flavor.

items.name: Apricots
items.desc: showing small golden-orange fruit, velvety skin, round to slightly oval, smaller than peach

items.name: Apricots - Dried
items.desc: dried apricots are typically small, irregularly wrinkled pieces, ranging in color from bright orange to a deeper brownish-orange. they have a chewy, somewhat leathery texture and are often flattened or shriveled. their shape is vaguely heart-like or oval, distinct from plump, fresh apricots.

items.name: Apricots - Large
items.desc: these large, small round to oval stone fruits have a soft, velvety skin that ranges from pale yellow to a vibrant orange, often with a reddish blush. a distinct suture line runs from the stem to the blossom end. their texture is soft when ripe.

items.name: Apriums
items.desc: showing fuzzy apricot-like skin, apricot-plum hybrid, mostly apricot appearance

items.name: Armenian Cucumber
items.desc: a long, slender cucumber, often 1-2 feet in length, with distinctive deep, longitudinal ridges and a slightly fuzzy skin. its color is light green, and it often has a slightly curved or twisted appearance.

items.name: Arracach
items.desc: a starchy root vegetable, typically oblong or conical in shape, tapering at one end. its skin is a brownish-yellow to light purple, often rough and uneven, while the interior flesh is usually white, yellow, or purplish. it resembles a parsnip or thick carrot but with a more knobby, irregular surface.

items.name: Artichoke
items.desc: showing large green tight overlapping leaf bracts forming globe shape, thorny tips

items.name: Artichokes - Baby/Cocktail
items.desc: baby or cocktail artichokes are miniature versions of the standard globe artichoke, typically green or slightly purple-tinged. they are significantly smaller, often just 1-2 inches in diameter, with tender, less thorny leaves and a very compact, undeveloped heart. they are almost bite-sized.

items.name: Artichokes - Extra Large
items.desc: a large, globe-shaped flower bud, typically 4-6 inches in diameter, characterized by many layers of tightly overlapping, tough, green-purple pointed leaves (bracts). it has a firm, dense texture and a short, thick stem.

items.name: Artichokes - Purple (Large)
items.desc: large purple artichokes are robust, globe-shaped vegetables, distinguished by their prominent reddish-purple color on the outer leaves. they have thick, overlapping scales and a substantial size, notably larger than their small counterparts. the overall form is compact and spiny.

items.name: Artichokes - Purple (Small)
items.desc: small purple artichokes exhibit a deep reddish-purple hue on their outer leaves, often transitioning to green closer to the base. they maintain the characteristic compact, globe-like shape with overlapping scales, similar to green varieties but distinctly colored. this size is smaller compared to typical artichokes.

items.name: Artichokes - Rouge Salambo
items.desc: a globe-shaped vegetable with tightly overlapping, fleshy bracts. this specific variety is notable for its vibrant deep red to reddish-purple outer bracts, which can have green tips, contrasting with the paler green or creamy interior. it has a thistle-like appearance, roughly the size of a fist to a small melon, with a robust stem base.

items.name: Artichokes - Small
items.desc: small green globe artichokes are characterized by their tightly overlapping, scale-like leaves forming a compact, spherical shape. they have a deep green color, sometimes with purple tips, and a firm, thorny texture. this size is noticeably smaller than standard artichokes.

items.name: Arugula
items.desc: dark green, deeply lobed leaves with a distinctive peppery taste. the leaves are tender, elongated, and often have slightly serrated edges, growing in small bunches or loose leaves. its individual leaves are typically smaller and more delicate than spinach or romaine.

items.name: Asian Pears
items.desc: showing round apple-like shape, golden-brown speckled skin, crisp texture

items.name: Asian/Nashi Pears - Brown
items.desc: these pears are round and apple-shaped, setting them apart from european pears. the skin is thin, ranging from golden-brown to a deeper tan, and is heavily textured with prominent russeting, giving it a slightly rough feel. inside, the flesh is crisp, juicy, and notably firm.

items.name: Asian/Nashi Pears - White
items.desc: these pears have a distinct round, apple-like shape, rather than the traditional pear taper. their skin is thin, pale yellow to off-white, and often shows light, visible russeting, which are small brown specks. the flesh is exceptionally crisp and juicy, offering a firm texture unlike softer european pear varieties.

items.name: Asparagus - Green (Large)
items.desc: large green asparagus stalks are long and slender, featuring vibrant emerald green color that may fade to a paler green or white at the base. they have delicate, scale-like leaves forming a tight, pointed spear at the tip. these stalks are notably thicker and more substantial than standard or thin asparagus.

items.name: Asparagus - Green Bunch
items.desc: long, slender green stalks with tightly closed, scale-like tips resembling small pinecones. the stems are smooth, firm, and range in color from a pale green at the base to a darker, vibrant green towards the tip, often bundled together for sale. each stalk is typically 6-10 inches long and pencil-thin to slightly thicker.

items.name: Asparagus - Purple
items.desc: imagine what asparagus would look like if it was entirely deep purple burgundy violet colored instead of green, a small bundle of 5-6 spears that are vivid dark purple from base to tip with no green whatsoever, the stalks have the shape of asparagus but the color of eggplant skin or dark plums, deep saturated purple-violet color throughout, smooth firm straight spears with tightly closed pointed tips that are the darkest purple

items.name: Asparagus - Purple Bunch
items.desc: imagine what a bunch of asparagus would look like if it was entirely deep purple burgundy violet colored instead of green, a thick bundle of 10-12 spears held together with a band that are vivid dark purple from base to tip with no green whatsoever, the stalks have the shape of asparagus but the color of eggplant skin or dark plums, deep saturated purple-violet color throughout, smooth firm straight spears with tightly closed pointed tips that are the darkest purple

items.name: Asparagus - Tips
items.desc: these are the delicate, edible spear tips of asparagus, typically 4-6 inches long. they have a tender, vibrant green stalk that gradually lightens to a purplish or pale green at the very tip, which is tightly closed and scale-like. the texture is smooth and slightly ridged.

items.name: Asparagus - White (Large)
items.desc: large creamy white vegetable spears — imagine what asparagus would look like if it was entirely creamy white ivory colored instead of green, a bundle of 6-8 thick pure white ivory colored spears tied together, every stalk is pale cream white from base to tip with no green whatsoever, the stalks have the shape of asparagus but the color of white candles, thick robust stalks notably larger than standard asparagus, smooth firm texture with tightly closed pointed tips

items.name: Asparagus - White (Small)
items.desc: small thin creamy white vegetable spears — imagine what asparagus would look like if it was entirely creamy white ivory colored instead of green, a small bundle of thin pure white ivory colored spears, every stalk is pale cream white from base to tip with no green whatsoever, the stalks have the shape of asparagus but the color of white candles, thin delicate stalks noticeably smaller than standard asparagus, smooth texture with pointed tips

items.name: Asparagus - White Bunch
items.desc: a bunch of creamy white vegetable spears — imagine what asparagus would look like if it was entirely creamy white ivory colored instead of green, a thick bundle of 10-12 pure white ivory colored spears held together with a rubber band, every stalk is pale cream white from base to tip with no green whatsoever, the stalks have the shape of asparagus but the color of white candles or ivory piano keys, smooth firm straight stalks with tightly closed pointed tips

items.name: Asparagus, Green
items.desc: showing long thin green spears with tight pointed tips, sold in bunch

items.name: Atemoyas
items.desc: single whole uncut heart-shaped or conical fruit with a distinct pale green, bumpy skin showing slight indentations or fingerprint-like textures between segments. do not show the fruit cut open. exterior only, about 4-6 inches in diameter.

items.name: Aura Apples
items.desc: aura apples present a beautiful bi-color appearance, typically displaying a vibrant crimson blush over a bright yellow-green background, often with distinct striping. they are medium to large in size, with a slightly conical shape and a smooth, waxy skin. the red blush is often very pronounced.

items.name: Aurora/Southern Rose Apples - Large
items.desc: large, conical to round-conical apples featuring a vibrant crimson blush that covers a significant portion of their creamy yellow-green background, often with visible lenticels. they possess crisp, juicy, and aromatic white flesh. this specific variant is notably larger than typical apple sizes.

items.name: Aurora/Southern Rose Apples - Small
items.desc: these are small, round to slightly conical apples. the skin features a pale yellow-green background largely overlaid with a rosy red blush and subtle striping. they possess a firm, crisp texture and a balanced sweet-tart flavor.

items.name: AutumnCrisp Grapes
items.desc: autumncrisp grapes are large, elongated oval-shaped, with a pale green to yellowish-green, crisp skin. they have a firm, snappy texture and often appear slightly translucent. they form loose to medium clusters and are distinguished by their larger size and prominent oval shape compared to typical green seedless grapes.

items.name: Avocado, Green, Large
items.desc: showing smooth bright green skin, larger than hass, florida type

items.name: Avocado, Green, Small
items.desc: showing smooth bright green skin, larger than hass, florida type

items.name: Avocado, Hass, Large
items.desc: showing dark pebbly textured skin, oval pear shape, hass variety

items.name: Avocado, Hass, Small
items.desc: showing dark pebbly textured skin, oval pear shape, hass variety

items.name: Avocado, Hass, XL
items.desc: showing dark pebbly textured skin, oval pear shape, hass variety

items.name: Avocados - Cocktail/Seedless
items.desc: distinctively slender, elongated, and cylindrical, resembling a small cucumber or gherkin. it has a smooth, typically dark green skin that is often edible. a key feature is the absence of a large pit, making it entirely edible except for the thin stem. approximately 2-3 inches in length.

items.name: Avocados - Green (Medium)
items.desc: a medium-sized, pear-shaped fruit, typically 4-6 inches long, with a dark, pebbly, somewhat rough skin that turns from green to purplish-black when ripe. it contains a large central pit.

items.name: Avocados - Green - Large
items.desc: pear-shaped fruit with a smooth, bright green, relatively thin skin that stays green when mature. features creamy, pale green to yellow flesh with a large central pit. this is the larger variant of green-skinned avocados, typically 6-8 inches in length, noticeably larger than the 'small' green avocado.

items.name: Avocados - Green - Small
items.desc: pear-shaped fruit characterized by a smooth, bright green, relatively thin skin that remains green even when ripe. it contains creamy, pale green to yellow flesh with a proportionally large central pit. this is the smaller variant of green-skinned avocados, typically 4-6 inches in length.

items.name: Avocados - Pinkerton
items.desc: pinkerton avocados are distinctively long and pear-shaped with a small, elongated neck. their skin is medium-thick, green, slightly pebbly, and easy to peel, maintaining its green color even when ripe. they contain a small seed and have a rich, creamy, nutty-flavored green flesh with a high oil content.

items.name: Babaco
items.desc: the babaco is an elongated, pentagonal fruit, typically green to yellow-green in color, ripening to a bright yellow. it has five distinct ridges running its length, giving it a star-like cross-section. the skin is smooth and waxy.

items.name: Baby Acorn Squash
items.desc: baby acorn squash retains the classic ribbed, acorn-like shape but is significantly smaller, usually fitting comfortably in the palm of a hand. its hard, thick rind is typically dark green, often with patches of orange or yellow where it rested on the ground. a short, stubby stem is present at the top.

items.name: Baby Bananas
items.desc: showing very small 3-4 inch chubby yellow banana, nino/lady finger variety

items.name: Baby Broccoli
items.desc: baby broccoli features slender, elongated green stalks topped with small, tightly packed dark green florets, similar to miniature standard broccoli heads. it has fewer leaves and a more tender, less fibrous stalk than mature broccoli, often with a slightly purplish tint near the base of the florets.

items.name: Baby Cactus Leaves (Nopales)
items.desc: baby cactus leaves are flat, oval to paddle-shaped pads, typically bright to medium green, and smaller than mature nopales. they have a slightly waxy, smooth surface, often with small, raised nubs where spines were removed, or very tiny, soft glochids if not completely clean. the edges are typically smooth or slightly undulating.

items.name: Baby Gai Choy (Chinese/Indian Mustard)
items.desc: baby gai choy features vibrant green, crinkly or ruffled leaves with prominent white or pale green veins and slender, tender stems. the leaves are typically broader and more elongated than many other leafy greens, forming a loose, non-heading bunch. it has a slightly pungent, peppery aroma characteristic of mustard greens.

items.name: Baby Green Zucchini/Courgette
items.desc: a miniature version of standard green zucchini, typically 3-6 inches in length. it has a smooth, glossy, dark green skin with a tender texture, often with a slight speckling. the shape is uniformly cylindrical.

items.name: Baby Parsnip
items.desc: small, tapered root vegetable with creamy white skin, significantly smaller and more slender than mature parsnips. they have a smooth surface and often retain a short green stem at the top.

items.name: Baby Scallopini Squash
items.desc: small, round, flattened, disk-shaped squash with distinctly scalloped edges. it typically has a pale green or sometimes yellow-white skin, smooth and delicate. often measures 1-3 inches in diameter.

items.name: Baby Spinach
items.desc: baby spinach consists of small, delicate, dark green leaves with a slightly crinkled or smooth texture. the leaves are typically oval to spade-shaped, much smaller and more tender than mature spinach leaves, and are often sold pre-washed in bags or clamshells.

items.name: Baby Summer Green Squash
items.desc: a small, elongated, cylindrical squash with smooth, bright green skin. it's slender, tapering slightly at the ends, and measures typically 3-5 inches long. the texture is firm and delicate.

items.name: Baby Sweet Corn
items.desc: very small, immature ears of corn, typically 2-4 inches long, pale yellow to whitish in color, often still encased in delicate, papery husks that are removed before sale. the kernels are underdeveloped and the texture is crisp and tender.

items.name: Banana Leaves
items.desc: very large, broad, and pliable green leaves, typically sold folded or rolled. they possess a smooth, somewhat waxy surface and prominent central veins. primarily used for wrapping food during steaming or grilling, imparting a subtle aroma without being eaten.

items.name: Banana Pepper
items.desc: long 4-6 inch pepper, bright yellow, curved banana shape, smooth waxy skin

items.name: Banana Squash
items.desc: a very large, elongated squash, often curved, resembling an oversized banana in shape. the skin can vary from pale yellow, orange, to pinkish-orange, typically smooth but sometimes slightly ridged, and can grow to several feet in length.

items.name: Bananas
items.desc: showing classic yellow curved elongated banana, cavendish variety

items.name: Bananas, Small
items.desc: showing smaller version of yellow banana

items.name: Bartlett Pears - Red
items.desc: these pears exhibit the classic pear shape, characterized by a rounded bottom that tapers gracefully into a distinct neck. the skin is a vibrant, uniform crimson red, sometimes displaying faint yellowing near the stem or base. when ripe, the juicy, sweet flesh softens considerably.

items.name: Bartlett Pears, Large
items.desc: showing classic bell-shaped pear, yellow-green ripening to yellow, smooth skin

items.name: Bartlett Pears, Small
items.desc: showing classic bell-shaped pear, yellow-green ripening to yellow, smooth skin

items.name: Basil
items.desc: showing medium smooth oval bright green leaves, slightly cupped, aromatic herb

items.name: Basil - Opal
items.desc: distinctive deep purple to almost black leaves, sometimes with green undertones. the leaves are broadly oval and slightly wrinkled, similar in shape and texture to sweet basil but with a striking coloration that sets it apart from all other green herbs.

items.name: Basil - Sweet
items.desc: vibrant green, broadly oval leaves with a slightly glossy and often somewhat wrinkled surface. the leaves are tender and emit a strong, sweet, aromatic scent when bruised. it's distinguished from other green herbs by its larger, more rounded leaves compared to smaller-leafed herbs like thyme or oregano.

items.name: Bay Leaves
items.desc: fresh bay leaves are stiff, oblong, and leathery, typically 1 to 3 inches long, with a dark green, glossy surface. they have a prominent central vein and smooth, slightly wavy edges. their distinctive elliptical shape and tough texture set them apart from other fresh herbs.

items.name: Bean Sprouts - Mung Bean Sprouts
items.desc: mung bean sprouts consist of a delicate white stem, typically 2-3 inches long, topped with a small, pale yellow or light green cotyledon (the bean part) and sometimes a tiny root tail. they are crisp, moist, and often sold in plastic bags or containers.

items.name: Beans - Winged
items.desc: winged beans are distinctive green pods, typically 6-9 inches long, with four prominent, wavy, or frilly longitudinal 'wings' running down their length. the pod has a slightly waxy sheen and a crisp, firm texture, often with a subtle ridge between the wings.

items.name: Beefsteak Tomatoes
items.desc: these are large, round, and often slightly flattened tomatoes with a vibrant red or sometimes reddish-orange skin. they have a firm, meaty texture and can show slight ribbing at the top. their substantial size and dense flesh distinguish them from smaller tomato varieties.

items.name: Beet Greens
items.desc: beet greens are large, dark green leaves with prominent reddish or purplish veins and petioles (stems). the leaves are typically broad and somewhat crinkled, similar in appearance to swiss chard, and are sold as a loose bunch without the beet root.

items.name: Beets - Baby Golden
items.desc: baby golden beets are small, round or slightly flattened root vegetables, typically 1-2 inches in diameter. their skin and flesh are a vibrant golden-yellow color, contrasting with the dark red of common beets. they often have delicate green stems attached.

items.name: Beets - Baby Red
items.desc: baby red beets are small, globular root vegetables, typically 1-2 inches in diameter. they feature a smooth, deep reddish-purple skin and interior flesh, often displaying faint concentric rings when cut. delicate green stems may still be attached.

items.name: Beets - Bunch
items.desc: bunched beets consist of 3-5 medium-sized beets, typically 2-3 inches in diameter, still attached to their vibrant, leafy green tops by their stems. the roots are deep red-purple, round or tapered, while the greens are dark green with reddish veins, resembling chard.

items.name: Beets, Loose
items.desc: showing round globe shape, dark red-purple skin, rough texture

items.name: Belchard Chantecler Apples
items.desc: belchard chantecler apples are medium to large, often irregular in shape, with a distinctive dull golden-yellow skin that frequently has a rough, russeted texture. they can exhibit some reddish-orange blush, but the dominant color is yellow-gold. the flesh is firm, crisp, and aromatic.

items.name: Belgian Endive
items.desc: belgian endive is a small, tightly packed head of pale, elongated leaves, resembling a torpedo or cigar shape, typically 4-6 inches long. the leaves are crisp, firm, and range in color from creamy white at the base to a pale yellow-green at the tips, often with slight reddish-purple edges if grown exposed to light.

items.name: Belgian Endive - Red
items.desc: a compact, torpedo-shaped head of tightly packed, crisp leaves, distinguished by its vibrant reddish-purple edges that gradient into a creamy white or pale yellow base. the leaves are smooth, slightly bitter, and spoon-shaped, forming a cylindrical 'chicon' that typically fits in the palm of a hand.

items.name: Belgica Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round to slightly conical apple with a smooth, glossy skin. the skin is a deep, uniform ruby red color, often with subtle vertical streaks or a slight orange tint. it has a firm flesh and a prominent stem.

items.name: Bell Pepper - Green - Large
items.desc: a large, blocky bell pepper with four distinct lobes and a thick, glossy, deep emerald green skin. it has a firm, crisp texture and a sweet, slightly bitter flavor. this is the larger size variant of the common green bell pepper.

items.name: Bell Pepper - Green - Small
items.desc: a small, blocky bell pepper with four distinct lobes and a thick, glossy, deep emerald green skin. it has a firm, crisp texture and a sweet, slightly bitter flavor. this is the smaller size variant of the common green bell pepper.

items.name: Bell Pepper - Purple
items.desc: this bell pepper is notable for its striking deep purple to almost black skin, which is smooth and glossy. it has a classic blocky shape with visible lobes. the vibrant, unusual color is its primary distinguishing characteristic compared to other bell peppers.

items.name: Bell Pepper, Brown (Field Grown)
items.desc: a blocky, bell-shaped pepper with a smooth, glossy skin that transitions from deep green to a rich, dark brown, often with hints of red or yellow underneath. it has thick walls and distinct lobes. its color is much darker than typical red or yellow bell peppers.

items.name: Bell Pepper, Brown (Greenhouse)
items.desc: this bell pepper features a distinctive rich, dark brown skin, resembling chocolate, with a glossy and smooth surface. it retains the typical blocky shape and firm texture of other bell peppers. its deep, earthy color makes it visually unique.

items.name: Bell Pepper, White (Field Grown)
items.desc: a distinctively pale, almost milky white to ivory bell-shaped pepper with a smooth, firm, glossy skin. it has a blocky form with 3-4 lobes. its light, almost translucent color sets it apart from green or yellow bell peppers.

items.name: Bell Pepper, White (Greenhouse)
items.desc: this bell pepper is characterized by its crisp, pale white to ivory skin, which is smooth and glossy. it maintains the classic blocky shape with distinct lobes. its unique color distinguishes it from more common bell pepper varieties.

items.name: Belle du Jumet Pear (Honey Belle)
items.desc: the belle du jumet pear is a medium to large-sized pear with a classic pear shape, broad at the base and tapering towards the stem. its skin is typically greenish-yellow, often developing a slight reddish blush on the sunny side, and can be somewhat russeted. the flesh is very sweet, juicy, and aromatic, distinguishing it as a dessert pear. the texture is smooth and melting.

items.name: Bertanne/Golden Russet Apples
items.desc: these apples are medium-sized with a distinctive, coarse russeted skin that gives them a golden-brown, sometimes patchy, appearance. the texture of the skin is rough and dry, covering a firm, somewhat elongated fruit. they typically have little to no blush, appearing uniformly earthy brown-gold.

items.name: Beurre Hardy Pears
items.desc: beurre hardy pears are medium to large, classic pyriform (pear-shaped) with a stocky neck and a full, rounded base. their skin is a distinctive dull, greenish-yellow, almost entirely covered with a fine, uniform russeting, giving it a somewhat rough, matte texture. the flesh is white, meltingly tender, and intensely juicy with a rich, sweet, and aromatic flavor.

items.name: Bi-Color Sweet Corn
items.desc: an ear of sweet corn, usually 6-9 inches long, encased in green husks with a silk tassel at the top. the kernels, once husked, are a distinct mix of bright yellow and white, tightly packed in rows around the cob.

items.name: Black Currants
items.desc: small, glossy, spherical berries, black currants are deep purple to almost black in color with a smooth, thin skin. they grow in clusters along a stem, similar to grapes but much smaller. each berry typically has a small, dried calyx at one end.

items.name: Black Forest Mushrooms
items.desc: showing small dark brown to black cap, similar to cremini but darker

items.name: Black Grapes, Seeded
items.desc: showing small round very dark purple-black grapes in bunch

items.name: Black Grapes, Seedless
items.desc: showing small round very dark purple-black grapes in bunch

items.name: Black Plumcot
items.desc: small to medium-sized fruit, round to slightly oval. the skin is smooth, thin, and a very dark, almost black-purple color, often with a dusty white bloom that can be rubbed off. it has a firm texture and a single central pit.

items.name: Black Raspberries
items.desc: showing black aggregate drupelets, hollow center like raspberry, smaller and rounder than blackberry

items.name: Black Sapote
items.desc: round to slightly flattened fruit, about the size of a tomato, with a thin, glossy, dark green skin that turns almost black when fully ripe and very soft. the striking feature is its jet-black, soft, gelatinous flesh, which has a texture and color similar to chocolate pudding, and contains a few flat, black seeds.

items.name: Black Velvet Apricot
items.desc: a striking fruit with deep, velvety, reddish-purple skin that can appear almost black, covered in a fine fuzz. it has a round to slightly oval shape, similar to a small plum. the flesh is a juicy, firm, and sweet orange-red, contrasting beautifully with the dark skin, and it contains a single pit.

items.name: Blackberries
items.desc: showing black-purple aggregate drupelets, elongated oval shape, solid core

items.name: Blackeyed Peas
items.desc: small, oval-shaped legumes typically sold in pods or shelled. the distinguishing feature is a prominent black 'eye' or spot on their creamy white to pale yellow surface. the pods are long, slender, and green, often slightly bumpy.

items.name: Blood Oranges
items.desc: showing whole orange with reddish blush or mottling on skin, with a cut half laid perpendicular beside it revealing deep crimson-red flesh inside

items.name: Blueberries
items.desc: showing small blue-indigo berry with dusty white bloom, round, smooth, tiny crown on top

items.name: Boiling Onions
items.desc: showing small white or yellow onion, about 1 inch, round

items.name: Bok Choy
items.desc: showing thick white stalks with dark green spoon-shaped leaves, chinese vegetable

items.name: Bok Choy - Shanghai
items.desc: features light green, broad, spoon-shaped leaves with pale green, short, thick stems that form a loose, squat head. it is generally smaller and rounder than standard bok choy, with a milder flavor.

items.name: Bok Choy - Small/Baby
items.desc: small/baby bok choy features petite, tender, loose heads typically 4-6 inches tall. it has bright white, crisp, spoon-shaped stalks that fan out to deep green, crinkly leaves. the stalks are significantly smaller and more delicate than standard bok choy, making the whole plant often sold intact.

items.name: Bon Rouge Pears
items.desc: bon rouge pears are medium to large, typically exhibiting a classic pyriform shape. their most distinguishing feature is the vibrant red blush that covers a significant portion of their smooth, green-yellow skin, often with subtle streaking. this striking red coloration makes them stand out visually from other green or russeted pear varieties.

items.name: Boniato
items.desc: boniato has a pale, reddish-purple skin that is thin and easily peeled, revealing its crisp, white flesh. it typically has an elongated, tapered shape, similar to a regular sweet potato but often with a smoother surface. the texture is starchy, and its flavor is subtly nutty and less sweet than orange varieties.

items.name: Borage
items.desc: borage is recognized by its large, elongated, oval-shaped leaves that are distinctly hairy or fuzzy to the touch, with a grayish-green color. it also features vibrant, star-shaped blue flowers, though these are often removed for culinary use of the leaves. the leaves have a mild cucumber-like flavor and a slightly succulent texture. it is usually sold in small bunches.

items.name: Bosc Pears, Large (East)
items.desc: these pears are easily identified by their elongated neck and elegantly tapering body. the skin is fully russeted, imparting a rough, uniform golden-brown or cinnamon-brown appearance. this particular item represents the larger size, making them notably more substantial than average bosc pears.

items.name: Bosc Pears, Large (West)
items.desc: showing long tapered neck, brown russeted skin, elegant elongated shape

items.name: Bosc Pears, Small (East)
items.desc: bosc pears have a distinctive, elongated neck and a body that tapers gradually. their skin is entirely russeted, giving it a rough, matte texture and a color that is consistently golden-brown or cinnamon-brown, almost like fine sandpaper. this specific item refers to smaller fruit, noticeably diminutive compared to standard bosc pears.

items.name: Bosc Pears, Small (West)
items.desc: showing long tapered neck, brown russeted skin, elegant elongated shape

items.name: Boskoop/Belle de Boskoop Apples - Large
items.desc: large, robust, roundish-conical apples characterized by a thick, rough, dull red skin often covered with considerable russeting and a prominent greenish-yellow background. the flesh is firm, tart, and coarse, making them excellent for baking. this is the larger size variant of this cooking apple.

items.name: Boskoop/Belle de Boskoop Apples - Small
items.desc: small, robust, roundish-conical apples characterized by a thick, rough, dull red skin often covered with considerable russeting and a prominent greenish-yellow background. the flesh is firm, tart, and coarse, making them excellent for baking. this is the smaller size variant of this cooking apple.

items.name: Boysenberries
items.desc: showing dark maroon-purple, large elongated aggregate fruit, larger than blackberry

items.name: Braeburn Apples, Large
items.desc: showing red-orange streaks over green-yellow base, bi-color appearance, semi-tall conical shape, visible green patches

items.name: Braeburn Apples, Small
items.desc: showing red-orange streaks over green-yellow base, bi-color appearance, semi-tall conical shape, visible green patches

items.name: Breadfruit
items.desc: large, round to ovoid fruit, typically light green to yellowish-green when ripe. its skin is rough and bumpy, covered with a distinct pattern of hexagonal markings. the fruit can weigh several pounds and has a starchy, potato-like texture when cooked, giving it its name.

items.name: Broccoli
items.desc: showing dark green tree-like floret cluster on thick stalk, compact flower head

items.name: Broccoli Crowns
items.desc: showing dark green floret cluster with stem trimmed short, crown only

items.name: Broccoli Florettes
items.desc: these are small, individual portions of the broccoli head, separated from the main stalk. each florette consists of a short, thick, pale green stem ending in a dense cluster of tiny, tightly packed dark green flower buds. the surface is slightly bumpy and firm, with a crisp texture.

items.name: Broccoli Rabe / Chinese Broccoli
items.desc: broccoli rabe features slender, edible stems with small, broccoli-like florets and large, jagged dark green leaves. chinese broccoli (gai lan) has thick, flat, glossy dark green leaves and thick stems, often topped with tiny white or yellow flowers. both are sold as loose bunches, distinctly different from standard broccoli crowns.

items.name: Brussels Sprouts
items.desc: showing very small miniature green cabbage-like heads, compact layered

items.name: Brussels Sprouts - Stalk
items.desc: brussels sprouts on the stalk feature numerous small, tight green cabbage-like buds arranged spirally along a thick, central stalk. the individual sprouts are typically 1-1.5 inches in diameter, bright green, and firm, resembling miniature cabbages. the stalk can be quite long, up to 2-3 feet.

items.name: Burro Bananas
items.desc: short and stout bananas with a distinctively square cross-section, especially when firm. the skin is a vibrant green, ripening to yellow with noticeable black spots. their flesh is firm, creamy white, and has a tangy-sweet flavor, generally smaller than common cavendish varieties.

items.name: Buttercup Squash
items.desc: showing dark green turban-shaped, round with distinctive cap on bottom

items.name: Butterkin Squash
items.desc: butterkin squash is a hybrid, resembling a smaller, rounder butternut squash with a distinct pumpkin-like top. its skin is smooth and tan to light orange, often with faint green streaks. the shape is typically bulbous at the bottom and narrower towards the stem, often with gentle ribs.

items.name: Butternut Squash
items.desc: showing tan/beige smooth skin, bell shape with long neck, peanut-like appearance

items.name: CIVG198 Apples
items.desc: a medium to large apple, typically round with a slightly flattened base, showcasing a bright, clear red blush that often covers much of the fruit. the red color often has visible yellow-green flecks or streaks underneath. its surface is smooth and firm.

items.name: Cabbage - Savoy, Red
items.desc: a large, round to slightly flattened head of cabbage, uniquely characterized by its crinkled, deeply textured leaves. this specific variety features a deep reddish-purple coloration across its heavily savoyed, bubbly surface, often with a paler purple or greenish-purple interior. the leaves are loosely packed compared to smooth cabbages and have a distinctive, almost velvety feel.

items.name: Cabbage - Summer Cabbage - Pointed type
items.desc: a distinctive cabbage with a conical or heart-shaped head, tapering to a pointed tip. its leaves are typically smooth, tender, and a vibrant light to medium green, though sometimes with a slightly yellowish tint. the head is less dense than traditional round cabbages, offering a softer texture and milder flavor.

items.name: Cactus Leaves (Nopales)
items.desc: cactus leaves, or nopales, are flat, oval-shaped pads, typically 4-8 inches long, with a vibrant green color and a thick, fleshy texture. the surface may show small bumps where spines were removed. they are firm yet flexible, with a slightly viscous interior when raw, which becomes tender with a mildly tart and earthy flavor when cooked.

items.name: Cactus Pear (Prickly Pear)
items.desc: oval-shaped fruit, typically ranging from red, purple, orange, to green. the skin is thick and covered with tiny hair-like spines (glochids), requiring careful handling. the flesh is juicy and sweet, containing numerous small, edible seeds.

items.name: Calabaza Squash
items.desc: showing large round to oval, mottled green and tan hard rind

items.name: California Sweet Onion
items.desc: showing pale yellow-tan large onion, flatter wider shape than regular yellow

items.name: Calypso Mango
items.desc: medium-sized, oval to oblong mango with a bright, blush-red skin over a yellow background, often developing an attractive pink-orange hue when fully ripe. it is prized for its fiber-free, firm, and intensely sweet flesh.

items.name: Cameo Apples, Large
items.desc: showing red-orange stripes over creamy yellow, lighter red than gala, mild striping with more exposed yellow

items.name: Cameo Apples, Small
items.desc: showing red-orange stripes over creamy yellow, lighter red than gala, mild striping with more exposed yellow

items.name: Canary Melon
items.desc: showing bright canary-yellow smooth oval rind, waxy surface

items.name: Cantaloupe
items.desc: showing tan beige netted rind with raised webbing pattern, round shape

items.name: Cantaloupe - Small
items.desc: small, spherical to slightly oblate melon with a distinctive raised, net-like (reticulated) rind pattern over a light tan to beige background. the flesh inside is typically orange, and the small size makes it easily identifiable from larger cantaloupes.

items.name: Cantaloupe/Muskmelon - Large
items.desc: a large, round to oblong melon, significantly bigger than its small counterpart, characterized by prominent, rough netting covering its muted tan-orange skin. it has a sweet, musky aroma when ripe, with succulent, deep orange flesh.

items.name: Cantaloupe/Muskmelon - Small
items.desc: a small, spherical to slightly oval melon with a distinctive raised, coarse netting pattern over its dull, light tan to pale orange skin. when ripe, it emits a sweet aroma and has firm, juicy, bright orange flesh surrounding a central seed cavity.

items.name: Cantared Apples
items.desc: cantared apples are medium-sized and round-conical in shape. their skin is a vibrant, deep red over a yellow-green base, often showing faint darker red stripes. they have firm, juicy flesh with a balanced sweet-tart taste.

items.name: Cape Gooseberry (Physalis)
items.desc: showing green to pale pink, small round, translucent with visible veins

items.name: Cape Rose Pears (Cheeky®)
items.desc: cape rose pears are medium-sized, with a squat, rounded bottom tapering to a short neck. their skin is typically a vibrant greenish-yellow base, heavily blushed with a distinct rose-red or crimson flush often covering more than half the surface. they have smooth, firm skin and may display subtle russeting near the stem.

items.name: Cardoon
items.desc: cardoon, also known as artichoke thistle, the entire plant must fit fully within the frame with generous space around all edges nothing cut off, a compact bundle of very wide flat silvery-grey stalks covered in fine white downy fuzz, prominent sharp ridges and rough fibrous texture, stalks much wider and flatter than celery, distinctly grey-silver not green, jagged spiny thistle-like leaf remnants along edges, thick woody base, shown at about 75 percent of the frame size so it fits completely

items.name: Carnival Squash
items.desc: showing multicolored green orange and white, acorn-shaped, festive pattern

items.name: Carrots - Baby
items.desc: small, stubby, uniformly cut pieces of peeled carrot, typically 1.5-2 inches long and bright orange. they have a smooth, moist surface and a slightly sweet, crunchy texture. often sold in sealed plastic bags, ready to eat.

items.name: Carrots - Bunch
items.desc: a bunch of 5-6 orange carrots bundled together with their green leafy tops still attached, tied together near the tops. multiple carrots visible, tapered roots fanning out slightly.

items.name: Carrots - Carrot Sticks
items.desc: uniformly cut, elongated sticks of peeled carrot, typically 3-4 inches long and about 1/4 inch thick. they are bright orange, have a smooth, moist surface, and a satisfyingly crunchy texture, designed for snacking and convenience.

items.name: Carrots - French
items.desc: medium-sized carrots, typically 4-6 inches long, with a cylindrical shape and a blunt tip, often sold with their vibrant green tops still attached. they have a smooth, bright orange skin and a crisp, sweet, tender flesh with a small, central core.

items.name: Carrots - Purple/Red - Beta Sweet
items.desc: long, tapered roots, typically 6-10 inches in length. the exterior skin is a vibrant purple or deep reddish-purple, often with an orange core visible when sliced, giving them a distinct two-toned appearance. they have a smooth to slightly rough texture.

items.name: Carrots, Loose
items.desc: showing long tapered orange root, smooth skin, classic conical shape

items.name: Casaba Melon
items.desc: showing bright yellow wrinkled rind, pointed at stem end, round shape

items.name: Cauliflower
items.desc: showing large white compact floret head surrounded by green leaves

items.name: Cauliflower - Baby
items.desc: a small, delicate version of cauliflower with a compact, rounded head of white florets. the florets are tightly clustered and have a slightly bumpy texture, often with more visible tender green leaves compared to full-sized cauliflower. it is noticeably smaller, often fitting in the palm of a hand.

items.name: Cauliflower - Florettes
items.desc: irregularly shaped, bite-sized pieces of white cauliflower, typically 1-2 inches in diameter, with a firm, slightly textured surface. they are usually sold pre-cut in bags or containers, ready for cooking or snacking, often without any green leaves.

items.name: Cauliflower - Green
items.desc: a distinct cauliflower head, typically 6-8 inches in diameter, characterized by its bright, vibrant lime green color across all its tightly packed florets. the florets have a slightly more textured, sometimes spiky appearance compared to white cauliflower, though still forming a dense head.

items.name: Cauliflower - Large
items.desc: a significantly larger, dense, rounded head of white florets, packed tightly. its surface is rough and bumpy. it is surrounded by large, pale green leaves and maintains a spherical to ovoid shape, noticeably bigger than standard cauliflower.

items.name: Cauliflower - Purple
items.desc: a striking cauliflower head, typically 6-8 inches in diameter, characterized by its deep, vibrant purple color across all its tightly packed florets. the color is natural due to anthocyanins and intensifies with cooking. it has a firm, slightly bumpy texture similar to white cauliflower.

items.name: Cauliflower - Romanesco
items.desc: a unique light green or chartreuse floreted vegetable with a fractal, spiraling pattern, forming a conical shape made up of many small, pointed spires arranged in a logarithmic spiral. the texture is firm and crunchy, visually distinct from standard cauliflower due to its intricate, geometric form.

items.name: Celery
items.desc: showing tall pale green ribbed stalks in bunch, leafy tops

items.name: Celery - Hearts
items.desc: a bundle of the tender, innermost stalks of celery, typically pale yellow to light green in color. the stalks are crisp, tightly packed, and often have small, delicate leaves attached at the top. they are shorter and more slender than full celery stalks, with a milder flavor.

items.name: Celery Bunch - Small
items.desc: a compact bunch of crisp, pale green to vibrant green stalks, tightly bound at the base. the stalks are noticeably thinner and shorter than standard celery, culminating in a small cluster of light green leaves at the top.

items.name: Celery Root (Celeriac)
items.desc: showing round knobby rough tan shape with rootlets, irregular bumpy

items.name: Celery Root - With Leaves Attached
items.desc: a large, knobby, off-white to light brown spherical root vegetable, roughly the size of a grapefruit, with a rough, uneven surface. it features a cluster of thin, bright green celery-like leaves and stalks extending from its top, indicating its freshness and connection to the plant. the root itself is firm and dense.

items.name: Celery, Bunch (Large)
items.desc: a large bunch of long, pale green, ribbed stalks, tapering into darker green leaves at the top. the stalks are crisp and connect at a fibrous base. this is the larger size, with thicker stalks and a fuller bunch compared to a smaller variant.

items.name: Celery, Bunch (Large)
items.desc: a large bunch of long, pale green, ribbed stalks, tapering into darker green leaves at the top. the stalks are crisp and connect at a fibrous base. this is the larger size, with thicker stalks and a fuller bunch, visually identical to plu 4582.

items.name: Celery, Loose Stalk
items.desc: showing individual pale green ribbed celery stalk

items.name: Champagne Grapes
items.desc: showing tiny pea-sized pale purple-red grapes in tight clusters

items.name: Chanterelle Mushrooms
items.desc: showing golden-yellow to apricot color, funnel trumpet shape, wavy irregular edges

items.name: Charentais Melon
items.desc: showing smooth gray-green rind with darker green sutures, small round shape

items.name: Charentais Melon - Extra Large
items.desc: this extra-large, round melon is characterized by its smooth, pale grey-green rind with prominent dark green sutures extending from end to end. the skin can take on a subtle yellowish tint when fully ripe. this is the extra-large variant of the charentais melon.

items.name: Charentais Melon - Large
items.desc: a small to medium, round melon with a smooth, pale gray-green skin covered in distinct dark green sutures or stripes. it has a sweet, aromatic orange flesh that is more intensely flavored than a typical cantaloupe. as a "large" variant, it would be at the upper end of the charentais size range, typically around 2-3 pounds.

items.name: Charentais Melon - Medium
items.desc: this medium-sized, round melon features a smooth, pale grey-green skin with distinct dark green sutures running from top to bottom. the skin may develop a slightly yellow hue as it ripens. this is the medium-sized variant of the charentais melon.

items.name: Charles Ross Apples
items.desc: a large, somewhat squat apple with a smooth, firm skin. the base color is a vibrant yellow-green, often developing a prominent orange-red flush and faint stripes on the sun-exposed side. its shape is typically rounded or slightly conical, with a moderately visible calyx.

items.name: Chasselas Grapes
items.desc: chasselas grapes are typically medium-sized, round, and grow in moderately compact bunches. their skin is thin and ranges in color from translucent pale green to golden-yellow when fully ripe, often with a slightly frosted bloom. they have a delicate, almost pearl-like appearance.

items.name: Chayote Squash
items.desc: showing pale green wrinkled pear shape, single large seed, light colored

items.name: Cherimoya
items.desc: heart-shaped or conical fruit with a distinctive, slightly bumpy, scale-like green skin that darkens as it ripens. the creamy white flesh is soft, sweet, and custardy, often described as a blend of pineapple, banana, and strawberry. it contains several large, shiny black seeds that are not edible.

items.name: Cherries - HR87 (Timberline)
items.desc: these are small, round, deep red fruits, typically with a short green stem attached. the skin is smooth and taut, with a slightly glossy finish. the flesh is juicy and sweet, surrounding a single hard pit.

items.name: Cherries - RL 100 (Audra Rose)
items.desc: these are small, round, firm fruits, displaying a vibrant, almost black-red color. they have a shiny, smooth skin and typically come with a firm, green stem. the flesh is dense and very sweet.

items.name: Cherries, Red/Black
items.desc: showing small deep red to dark burgundy fruit, heart-shaped, with stem

items.name: Cherry Tomatoes
items.desc: showing very small round red tomato, bite-sized

items.name: Chervil
items.desc: chervil is a delicate annual herb with finely divided, curly, light green leaves resembling flat-leaf parsley but more frilly and fern-like. it grows in small, bushy clumps and has a subtle, delicate flavor often described as a mild blend of parsley and anise. stems are thin and light green.

items.name: Chickpeas - Fresh
items.desc: small, roundish, pale green beans encased in fuzzy, light green pods, typically with 1-3 beans per pod. the pods are similar in texture to snow pea pods but are plumper and more bulbous. the individual beans are firm, light green, and have a slightly irregular, dimpled surface.

items.name: Chili Pepper - Dried
items.desc: small to medium-sized peppers that are shriveled and dark in color, often deep red, brown, or black, with a dry, leathery, and wrinkled texture. they maintain the general shape of fresh chili peppers but are significantly lighter and more brittle. stems are usually intact.

items.name: Chinese Eggplant
items.desc: chinese eggplants are long and slender, typically 6-12 inches in length, with a uniform cylindrical shape. their skin is a vibrant, glossy lavender to light purple, much lighter than common globe eggplants, and they have a very tender flesh with few seeds.

items.name: Chinese Long Beans
items.desc: these unique beans are exceptionally long and slender, typically ranging from 1 to 3 feet in length, with a uniform diameter. they are a vibrant light to medium green, sometimes with a pale purple tinge. the texture is firm and crisp, with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface, and they usually hang straight or with a gentle curve.

items.name: Chinese Yali Pears
items.desc: showing elongated shape with long neck, pale yellow-green, asian variety

items.name: Chipilin Leaf
items.desc: chipilin leaves are small, ovate to oblong, and a rich, deep green color, growing in clusters along slender, tender stems. the leaves are soft and delicate to the touch, similar in texture to baby spinach but generally smaller in size. they are often sold in small, loose bunches or as individual leaves.

items.name: Chives
items.desc: long, slender, hollow, grass-like green stalks, typically gathered in small bundles. they are bright green, uniform in diameter, and have a soft, pliable texture. visually, they resemble very thin scallions or thick blades of grass, but are much finer than most green onions.

items.name: Choy Sum
items.desc: a leafy green vegetable with slender, light green stems and oval-shaped, dark green leaves. it typically has small, bright yellow flowers clustered at the top of its stalks. the stems are crisp and the leaves are tender, forming a loose, upright bunch.

items.name: Choy Sum - Baby
items.desc: a smaller, more tender version of regular choy sum, typically reaching only 4-6 inches in height. it features delicate, light green stalks and small, tender dark green leaves, often without visible yellow flowers. the overall structure is more compact and uniform compared to mature choy sum.

items.name: Cilantro
items.desc: showing lighter green flat rounded scalloped leaves, thin stems, distinctive herb

items.name: Cinnabar Melon
items.desc: a medium-sized, round melon with a smooth, glossy rind that displays striking streaks or patches of deep green over a bright orange or cinnabar-red base. its flesh is typically pale green or white, very sweet and aromatic, with a tender texture.

items.name: Civni Apples
items.desc: civni apples are medium-sized, round-conical with a vibrant, glossy red skin that often has subtle yellow or green undertones. they have a firm, crisp flesh and a generally smooth surface. their appearance is bright and appealing.

items.name: Clara Friis Pears
items.desc: clara friis pears are small to medium-sized with a somewhat round to conical shape, less elongated than many traditional pears. their skin is smooth and thin, a delicate pale green that often develops a faint, attractive reddish blush on the sun-exposed side. the flesh is very juicy, sweet, and aromatic, often described as having a slight musky flavor.

items.name: Clementine Tangerine - Large
items.desc: these are the largest size of clementine tangerines, noticeably bigger than medium or small varieties, typically 2.5-3 inches in diameter. they maintain the classic bright orange, smooth, and easily peelable skin, with a slightly flattened spherical shape. the large, sweet, and juicy segments are typically seedless.

items.name: Clementine Tangerine - Medium
items.desc: this common citrus fruit is medium-sized, larger than small clementines but not as large as large clementines, typically 2-2.5 inches in diameter. it has a bright, uniform orange, easy-to-peel skin and a slightly flattened-sphere shape. the segments are seedless and known for their sweet, juicy flesh.

items.name: Clementine Tangerine - Small
items.desc: these small, seedless citrus fruits are easily recognized by their glossy, vibrant orange skin that is thin and peels effortlessly. they have a flattened-sphere shape and are significantly smaller than medium or large clementines, typically 1.5-2 inches in diameter. their flesh is juicy and very sweet.

items.name: Clementine Tangerine - Untreated
items.desc: these clementines are medium-sized, exhibiting a natural, often slightly duller orange color compared to waxed fruit, and may have minor imperfections on their skin. the peel, which is thin and easily removed, lacks the typical waxy sheen from post-harvest treatments. the fruit maintains the sweet, juicy, and typically seedless interior characteristic of clementines.

items.name: Clementine Tangerine - With Leaves
items.desc: these clementines are typically medium-sized, round to slightly flattened, with glossy, vibrant orange skin that is easy to peel. their defining visual characteristic is the fresh green leaves and a small stem still attached to the fruit, which often indicates recent harvesting and freshness. the flesh is sweet, juicy, and usually seedless.

items.name: Clementines
items.desc: very small, bright orange, seedless, very easy to peel, smooth glossy skin, round to slightly flat

items.name: Co-op 43 Apples
items.desc: a medium-sized, symmetrical apple, usually displaying a vibrant pinkish-red blush over a creamy yellow background. the color is often streaked or mottled rather than a solid block. it has a smooth, taut skin and a classic rounded shape.

items.name: Cocktail Tomatoes - On the Vine
items.desc: these are small, perfectly round, bright red tomatoes attached to a green vine or truss, typically in clusters. they are larger than cherry tomatoes but smaller than standard slicing tomatoes, with smooth, firm, glossy skin and a sweet, juicy interior.

items.name: Coconut, Husked
items.desc: showing large brown fibrous husk covering, oval-round shape

items.name: Coconut, In Husk
items.desc: showing large brown fibrous husk covering, oval-round shape

items.name: Collard Greens
items.desc: showing large flat dark blue-green leaves, thick stems, not frilly

items.name: Comice Pears
items.desc: showing squat round shape, yellow-green with possible red blush, short neck

items.name: Concord Grapes
items.desc: showing small dark blue-purple grapes with thick slip-skin, dusty bloom

items.name: Concorde Pears
items.desc: a single concorde pear only — no grapes no other fruit, just one pear, elongated conical shape slightly wider at the base, pale greenish-yellow skin with faint orange blush, light fine russeting especially towards the stem, medium to large size, smooth firm appearance

items.name: Conference Pears

items.name: Cox Orange Pippin Apples
items.desc: a cox orange pippin apple, round and slightly flattened, broad golden-yellow base color; the upper half has a warm orange-red blush that fades softly into the yellow, with subtle muted red streaking and fine pale speckles across the skin; short reddish-brown stem in a shallow stem cavity; slightly matte skin; gently uneven natural shape

items.name: Cranberries

items.name: Cremini Mushrooms

items.name: Crenshaw Melon
items.desc: a large, somewhat elongated and pointed melon, often described as teardrop or oval-shaped, with a smooth to slightly ribbed rind that ranges from yellow to golden-orange. its firm, aromatic flesh is typically pale salmon-orange, exceptionally sweet and juicy, with a distinct floral perfume.

items.name: Crimson Delight/Sunrise Magic Apples
items.desc: a medium to large, conical apple with a striking dark crimson red skin, often with subtle yellow-green undertones peeking through. its texture is firm and exceptionally crisp, yielding a juicy, sweet flesh.

items.name: Crimson Grapes
items.desc: showing medium deep crimson red seedless oval grapes

items.name: Cripps Red (Sundowner) Apples - Small
items.desc: cripps red apples are medium-sized, round-conical with a slightly flattened base. their skin is bright red over a yellow-green background, often with visible lenticels. they have a crisp, juicy texture and a sweet-tart flavor, and this specific item refers to the smaller size variant of this apple.

items.name: Cripps Red Apples - Large
items.desc: large, firm, and round to conical apples, cripps red apples are characterized by a deep, uniform ruby-red skin, sometimes with a faint yellow blush where less exposed. their surface is smooth and slightly waxy. this is a larger variety of red apple.

items.name: Crispin/Mutsu Apples, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: showing pale green-yellow color, very large round shape, crisp waxy appearance

items.name: Crispin/Mutsu Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: crispin/mutsu apples are very large, conical to oblong, with smooth, sometimes waxy, yellow-green skin that may have a slight blush. the flesh is firm, juicy, and creamy white. this is the larger size variant for crispin/mutsu apples.

items.name: Crispin/Mutsu Apples, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: showing pale green-yellow color, very large round shape, crisp waxy appearance

items.name: Crispin/Mutsu Apples, Small (West)
items.desc: crispin/mutsu apples are medium to large, conical to oblong, with smooth, sometimes waxy, yellow-green skin that may have a slight blush. the flesh is firm, juicy, and creamy white. this is the smaller size variant for crispin/mutsu apples.

items.name: Criterion Apples - Large
items.desc: large, conical-to-round apples with a greenish-yellow skin often flushed with a pale red blush, sometimes displaying faint stripes. the skin is smooth with small, inconspicuous lenticels. they are larger than average, fitting comfortably in an adult's palm.

items.name: Criterion Apples - Small
items.desc: criterion apples are small, round-conical with smooth, yellow-green skin often covered with a faint to medium red blush. their appearance is similar to a golden delicious but with a distinct red flush. the flesh is crisp and sweet. this is the smaller size variant for criterion apples.

items.name: Crown Prince Squash
items.desc: medium to large round squash with a distinctive steely blue-grey rind, often with a flattened top and bottom and deep ridges. its skin is hard and bumpy, and it has bright orange flesh inside.

items.name: Cubanelle Pepper
items.desc: long 4-6 inch pepper, light yellowish-green, thin walls, elongated wrinkled

items.name: Cucumber
items.desc: showing long cylindrical dark green cucumber with bumpy skin

items.name: Cucuzza Squash
items.desc: cucuzza squash is remarkably long and slender, frequently reaching lengths of 2-3 feet or more. it has a smooth, pale green, slightly waxy skin. the shape is generally straight or gently curved, often with a slightly wider, bulbous end, resembling an extremely elongated zucchini.

items.name: D'Estivale Apples
items.desc: these medium to large apples are somewhat flattened in shape. their skin is a bright yellow-green with an attractive orange-red blush and subtle striping, especially prominent on the sun-exposed side. the flesh is crisp, juicy, and aromatic with a refreshing tartness.

items.name: Daikon
items.desc: large, elongated white root vegetable, resembling a very large, pale carrot or parsnip. it has smooth, white skin and can grow up to 10-15 inches long and 2-4 inches in diameter. often tapers slightly towards the end and may have small rootlets and green leafy tops attached.

items.name: Dancy Tangerines
items.desc: showing deep orange-red, flat shape, loose peel

items.name: Dandelion Greens
items.desc: long, thin, deeply lobed or toothed leaves forming a rosette, typically dark green. they have a slightly bitter taste and a firm texture, often sold as a bunch with a visible white root crown.

items.name: Dates, Fresh
items.desc: showing small elongated oval golden-brown to dark brown, wrinkled sticky

items.name: Dazzle Apples
items.desc: dazzle apples are medium to large with a bright, glossy red skin that often has subtle yellow-green undertones. they have a firm, crisp flesh and a classic round to conical apple shape. their vibrant, uniform red color is a key visual identifier.

items.name: Decorative Painted Pumpkin
items.desc: exhibits a traditional pumpkin shape, often medium to large, but is characterized by its painted surface. the natural orange or white skin is covered with various designs, patterns, or faces in multiple colors, indicating it's intended for decoration rather than consumption. the paint is usually opaque and covers most of the pumpkin's surface.

items.name: Dekopon Tangerine/Mandarin
items.desc: a large, seedless mandarin known for its prominent, characteristic 'top knot' or bump at the stem end. its skin is a vibrant, deep orange, slightly bumpy and loose, making it exceptionally easy to peel. the fruit is notably heavy for its size, indicating its juiciness.

items.name: Delblush (Tentation) Apples
items.desc: these medium-sized apples have a bright, luminous golden-yellow skin that is smooth and often waxy. they frequently display a delicate pinkish-red blush, typically in patches or stripes, particularly on one side. the shape is typically round to slightly conical, with a firm, crisp texture.

items.name: Delicata Squash
items.desc: showing elongated cylinder, cream with green stripes, thin edible skin

items.name: Delta Seedless Oranges - Large
items.desc: these are large, sweet, and seedless oranges, characterized by their vibrant orange, slightly dimpled peel. significantly larger than the medium size, they can fill an adult's hand. they retain the classic round to slightly flattened shape and smooth, relatively thin peel of the delta seedless variety.

items.name: Delta Seedless Oranges - Medium
items.desc: these are a popular variety of sweet, seedless oranges with a bright orange, slightly textured peel. they are medium-sized, fitting comfortably in one hand, and typically have a round to slightly oblate shape. the skin is easy to peel, revealing juicy, segmented flesh.

items.name: Dessert Apples
items.desc: a medium-sized, classic apple shape, typically rounded with a slightly tapered bottom. the skin is smooth, often a blend of pale green and yellow, frequently adorned with a soft red or pink blush that can cover a significant portion or appear as subtle stripes. its texture is firm and crisp.

items.name: Dill
items.desc: showing feathery thread-like wispy blue-green fronds, tall thin stems

items.name: Dill - Baby
items.desc: feathery, delicate, bright green fronds with a fine, hair-like texture. the leaves are very finely dissected, giving them a soft, wispy appearance. baby dill is often sold in smaller bunches and is more tender and less robust than pickling dill.

items.name: Dill - Pickling
items.desc: robust, feathery green fronds with a more pronounced, slightly coarser texture than baby dill. it often includes thicker stems and sometimes small, nascent flower heads, indicating a more mature plant. its fronds are still finely divided but stand out as more substantial than the delicate baby dill.

items.name: Discovery Apples
items.desc: discovery apples are medium-sized and round with smooth, shiny skin. the color is predominantly a bright, clear red blush over a pale green-yellow base, often with faint red streaks. the flesh is crisp, white, and notably juicy with a refreshing, slightly strawberry-like flavor.

items.name: Dominique Bananas
items.desc: these cooking bananas are longer and straighter than typical dessert bananas, with a thick, dull green skin that lightens to yellow with dark spots when fully mature. the starchy, pale yellow flesh requires cooking before consumption, similar to plantains.

items.name: Dragon Fruit, Red
items.desc: showing whole bright pink-magenta fruit with green-tipped scale-like bracts, with a cut half laid perpendicular beside it revealing white flesh speckled with tiny black seeds

items.name: Dried Tomatoes
items.desc: showing dark red wrinkled dried tomato halves, concentrated

items.name: Durondeau Pears
items.desc: durondeau pears are medium to large, exhibiting a classic pyriform shape with a slightly irregular surface. their skin is vibrant yellow, heavily flushed with a deep, rosy red on the sun-exposed side, and often speckled with prominent reddish dots. the russeting is typically coarse and patch-like, particularly around the stem and blossom end, giving it a distinctive mottled appearance.

items.name: Dutch White Cabbage
items.desc: this cabbage forms a very dense, round, or slightly flattened head with tightly packed, firm leaves. the outer leaves are a pale green, transitioning to a creamy white or very pale yellow towards the core. the texture is crunchy and crisp, with a mild, slightly peppery flavor that sweetens when cooked.

items.name: Early Apples, Large
items.desc: large, generally round to slightly conical apples, exhibiting a greenish-yellow base color with an overlay of red stripes or a solid blush. the skin is typically smooth. these are larger than average, often requiring two hands to hold comfortably.

items.name: Early Apples, Large
items.desc: large, generally round to slightly conical apples, exhibiting a greenish-yellow base color with an overlay of red stripes or a solid blush. the skin is typically smooth. these are larger than average, often requiring two hands to hold comfortably.

items.name: Early Apples, Small
items.desc: small, typically round apples with a variable skin color ranging from light green to a pale red blush, sometimes with faint stripes. the skin is thin and smooth. these are noticeably smaller than most standard apples, fitting in the palm of a child's hand.

items.name: Early Apples, Small
items.desc: small, typically round apples with a variable skin color ranging from light green to a pale red blush, sometimes with faint stripes. the skin is thin and smooth. these are noticeably smaller than most standard apples, fitting in the palm of a child's hand.

items.name: Eggplant
items.desc: showing large deep glossy purple-black oval to pear shape, green calyx at stem

items.name: Eggplant - Baby
items.desc: small, teardrop-shaped eggplant with shiny, deep purple skin. typically measures 2-4 inches in length and 1-2 inches in diameter. it has a smooth, firm surface and a small green calyx at the stem end, making it noticeably smaller than standard globe eggplants.

items.name: Eggplant - Baby White
items.desc: small, teardrop-shaped eggplant with smooth, glossy white skin. measures about 2-4 inches long and 1-2 inches wide, making it visually distinct from purple baby eggplants. features a small, bright green calyx at the top, contrasting sharply with its pristine white body.

items.name: Eggplant - Japanese
items.desc: long, slender eggplant with shiny, dark purple to black skin. it typically measures 6-10 inches in length and 1-2 inches in diameter, much thinner and more elongated than traditional globe eggplants. has a prominent green calyx at the stem end.

items.name: Eggplant - White
items.desc: medium-sized, oval to teardrop-shaped eggplant with smooth, glossy white skin. larger than baby white eggplants, typically 4-7 inches long and 2-4 inches wide. it maintains a distinct bright white coloration with a contrasting green calyx, appearing robust and uniformly pale.

items.name: Elephant Garlic
items.desc: significantly larger than standard garlic, typically the size of a small apple or orange. it has fewer, very large cloves encased in a papery, white or light tan skin, with a distinctly milder flavor than common garlic.

items.name: Ellendale Tangerine
items.desc: this mandarin hybrid is medium to large for a tangerine, with a slightly flattened shape. its skin is a deep, glossy orange-red, relatively thin, and adheres tightly to the sweet, highly aromatic, and juicy pulp. the fruit is typically very heavy for its size due to high juice content and often contains seeds.

items.name: Elongated Green Pepper
items.desc: long and blocky pepper with a deep, glossy green skin. it has a slightly tapered shape, generally thicker-walled than standard bell peppers, with 3-4 lobes. the length can be up to 6-8 inches.

items.name: Elongated Orange Pepper
items.desc: long and blocky pepper with a vibrant, glossy orange skin. it has a slightly tapered shape, generally thicker-walled than standard bell peppers, with 3-4 lobes. the length can be up to 6-8 inches.

items.name: Elongated Red Pepper
items.desc: long and blocky pepper with a vibrant, glossy red skin. it has a slightly tapered shape, generally thicker-walled than standard bell peppers, with 3-4 lobes. the length can be up to 6-8 inches.

items.name: Elongated White Pepper
items.desc: long and blocky pepper with a pale, creamy white or yellowish-white glossy skin. it has a slightly tapered shape, generally thicker-walled than standard bell peppers, with 3-4 lobes. the length can be up to 6-8 inches.

items.name: Elongated Yellow Pepper
items.desc: long and blocky pepper with a bright, glossy yellow skin. it has a slightly tapered shape, generally thicker-walled than standard bell peppers, with 3-4 lobes. the length can be up to 6-8 inches.

items.name: Elstar Apples - Large
items.desc: large, conical-round apples with a bright red-orange blush covering a yellow base, often with faint stripes. the skin is smooth and firm. these are significantly larger than a standard apple, often requiring a firm grip with one hand.

items.name: Elstar Apples, Small
