items.name: Emmons Apples
items.desc: large, round to slightly oblate apple. its skin is a vibrant, deep crimson red, often with a slight waxy feel and prominent small white lenticels. the color is usually quite uniform, covering most of the fruit, sometimes with a faint green-yellow undertone near the stem.

items.name: Empire Apples, Large (East/Central)

items.name: Empire Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: large, uniformly round apples with a deep, glossy crimson red skin, often with a faint green blush visible around the stem or calyx. the skin is smooth and firm. these are notably larger than average apples, fitting substantially in an adult's hand.

items.name: Empire Apples, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: showing dark purplish-red almost uniform color, small and round, thicker skin, very little green showing

items.name: Empire Apples, Small (West)
items.desc: small, uniformly round apples with a deep, glossy crimson red skin that may have faint green undertones near the stem. the skin is smooth and firm. these are smaller than typical apples, easily held in one hand with room to spare.

items.name: Endive/Chicory
items.desc: compact, elongated head of pale green to yellow-white leaves, often with a slightly bitter taste. the leaves are crisp and can be either tightly furled into a torpedo shape (belgian endive) or curly and frilly (curly endive), measuring 4-8 inches long. distinctive for its tightly packed appearance or feathery texture.

items.name: English Cucumber
items.desc: showing very long narrow dark green cucumber, smooth thin skin, often wrapped in plastic

items.name: Enoki Mushrooms
items.desc: showing very long thin white stems in clusters, tiny round caps, delicate noodle-like appearance

items.name: Epazote
items.desc: epazote is characterized by its slender, deeply lobed or toothed leaves, typically a vibrant green color. the leaves grow alternately along a thin stem and have a somewhat rough, matte texture. it has a pungent, strong aroma that is often described as medicinal, citrusy, and petroleum-like, and grows in clusters of leafy stems.

items.name: Escarole - Red
items.desc: a broad-leaved endive with slightly curly, ruffled leaves that transition from a pale yellow or white heart to a vibrant dark green, with distinct reddish or purplish tints on the outer edges and tips. the leaves are sturdy, forming a loose head. the texture is crisp with a slightly bitter flavor.

items.name: Escarole/Batavian Chicory - Green
items.desc: large, loose head of broad, wavy, and slightly curly green leaves. the outer leaves are darker green and tougher, while the inner leaves are paler green and more tender, forming a loose rosette. typically 8-12 inches in diameter, resembling a robust, frilly lettuce with substantial texture.

items.name: EverCrisp™ Apples
items.desc: evercrisp apples have a distinctive reddish-orange blush over a yellow-green background, often with visible russeting near the stem. they are medium to large, roundish-conical in shape, and possess a very firm, crisp texture.

items.name: Fairchild Tangerine/Mandarin
items.desc: this small, oblate citrus fruit is characterized by its deep orange-red, slightly pebbled skin that is typically very easy to peel. it has a flattened top and bottom and contains juicy, sweet flesh with few seeds. its vibrant color makes it distinct.

items.name: Fall Glo Tangerines
items.desc: showing bright reddish-orange, medium size, slightly pebbly skin

items.name: Fava Beans
items.desc: fava beans are large, plump pods, typically 6-10 inches long and thick, with a slightly fuzzy or velvety exterior. the pods are a pale to bright green, lumpy due to the seeds inside. when opened, they reveal 3-5 large, light green or cream-colored, kidney-shaped beans cushioned in a soft, cottony lining.

items.name: Feijoa
items.desc: small, oval-shaped fruit, typically green with a slightly rough or waxy skin. the flesh is grainy and juicy, with a sweet-tart flavor profile often described as a mix of pineapple, guava, and mint. it contains tiny, edible seeds concentrated in the gelatinous center.

items.name: Fennel (Anise)
items.desc: showing white bulbous base with green celery-like stalks, feathery fronds

items.name: Fennel Leaves
items.desc: fennel leaves are delicate and feathery, resembling dill, with a bright green color. they grow as fronds from the fennel bulb, characterized by their fine, hair-like segments. their soft texture and strong anise-like aroma help distinguish them from other leafy herbs.

items.name: Fiddlehead Ferns
items.desc: tight, coiled tips of young fern fronds, resembling the scroll of a violin (fiddlehead). they are bright to dark green, firm, and often covered in a delicate, papery brown husk that needs to be removed. typically 1-2 inches in diameter when coiled, found in small clusters.

items.name: Fiesta Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round apples with a vibrant red blush over a yellow-green background, often featuring distinct red stripes. the skin is smooth and slightly glossy. they are a typical apple shape, fitting comfortably in one hand.

items.name: Figs - Dried
items.desc: dried figs are shriveled and flattened, typically brown to purplish-black in color, with a tough, wrinkled outer skin. they have a chewy texture and a sweet, concentrated flavor, often with visible small, crunchy seeds inside. the shape vaguely resembles a flattened teardrop or bulb.

items.name: Figs, Black
items.desc: showing small dark purple-black teardrop shape, soft, mission variety

items.name: Figs, Brown
items.desc: showing small light brown to amber teardrop shape, turkey variety

items.name: Figs, White/Green
items.desc: showing small pale green to white teardrop shape, adriatic type

items.name: Fine Beans
items.desc: these beans are slender, delicate, and typically very straight, usually no wider than a pencil. they have a vibrant, dark green color and a tender-crisp texture. fine beans are typically 4-6 inches long, very stringless, and offer a more refined and less fibrous eating experience than standard green beans.

items.name: Fireside Apples - Large
items.desc: fireside apples are typically conical to round with a firm, slightly textured skin. they feature prominent red stripes over a yellow-green background. the flesh is crisp and sweet. this is the larger size variant for fireside apples.

items.name: Fireside Apples - Small
items.desc: fireside apples are typically conical to round with a firm, slightly textured skin. they feature prominent red stripes over a yellow-green background. the flesh is crisp and sweet. this is the smaller size variant for fireside apples.

items.name: Flamingo Pears
items.desc: flamingo pears are medium to large, with an attractive, symmetrical pyriform shape. their skin is smooth and thin, boasting a striking two-tone coloration: a bright, vibrant pinkish-red blush covers much of the pear, contrasting beautifully with a pale green or yellowish base. this distinct red-over-green coloring makes them visually stand out from other pear varieties.

items.name: Flat Peaches, White (Saturn/Donut)
items.desc: showing pale cream-white skin with slight pink blush, round with crease, fuzzy skin

items.name: Flat Yellow Nectarine
items.desc: flat yellow nectarines are distinctly disk-shaped, flattened on both ends like a doughnut or saucer. their smooth, fuzz-free skin has a vibrant yellow background, often with a prominent red blush. the flesh is yellow, very sweet, and freestone.

items.name: Foo Qua Bitter Melon
items.desc: an elongated, often cylindrical fruit with a bumpy, warty, or ridged exterior, typically green in color, ranging from light to dark. it has a distinct bitter taste and a hollow center with seeds.

items.name: Forelle Pears
items.desc: showing small pear, green with distinctive red freckling and lenticel dots

items.name: Francis Mango
items.desc: this medium-sized, s-shaped or oblong mango has a vibrant, smooth skin that ripens from greenish-yellow to a golden-yellow with pink or orange blushes. it often exhibits distinctive ridges or curves. the flesh is non-fibrous and intensely sweet.

items.name: French Afternoon Melon
items.desc: a medium-sized, round to slightly flattened melon with a deeply ribbed, pale yellow to golden-orange rind, often covered in subtle, fine netting. its firm, salmon-pink flesh is highly aromatic, very sweet, and has a rich, complex flavor.

items.name: French Breakfast Melon
items.desc: a small, perfectly round melon with a smooth, thin, grayish-green rind that develops subtle yellow or orange blush when ripe, often with faint dark green stripes. it possesses intensely sweet, fragrant, and vibrant orange flesh.

items.name: French Pears
items.desc: this general category typically encompasses european pear cultivars that can vary significantly in shape, from plump and round to the classic tear-drop. they often have tender, creamy flesh, and their skin can be smooth green, bright yellow, or russeted, depending on the specific varietal. the flavor is usually very sweet and highly aromatic.

items.name: Frisee
items.desc: a loose, airy head of finely divided, lacy leaves with a vibrant green outer layer that fades to a pale yellow or white heart. it has a crisp texture and a pleasant, slightly bitter flavor.

items.name: Fuji Apples, Large
items.desc: showing characteristic bicolor pink-red stripes over yellow-green base, round shape, dense heavy appearance, dull matte finish

items.name: Fuji Apples, Small
items.desc: showing characteristic bicolor pink-red stripes over yellow-green base, round shape, dense heavy appearance, dull matte finish

items.name: Fuji Brak Apples
items.desc: fuji brak apples are typically medium to large, roundish-conical, with a yellow-green base skin covered in vertical red-pink stripes and a prominent blush. they have a firm, crisp texture and a sweet, juicy flavor. the skin is smooth and slightly waxy.

items.name: GEM Avocados
items.desc: oval to pear-shaped with a thick, pebbly, dark green skin that ripens to a purplish-black. it has a slightly rougher texture than hass and a creamy, rich yellow-green flesh with a large central pit. the skin is moderately easy to peel when ripe.

items.name: GIGA® Apples
items.desc: giga® apples are large, round to slightly conical apples with a striking deep, uniform crimson red skin, often with a subtle waxy sheen. they have very few lenticels or blemishes, presenting a visually 'perfect' appearance. their flesh is extremely crisp and dense.

items.name: Gai Choy (Chinese Mustard)
items.desc: large, leafy greens with thick, crunchy stems. leaves are typically dark green, often with a slightly frilly or ruffled edge, and can have a peppery, mustard-like scent when crushed. the plant forms a loose head or individual large leaves.

items.name: Gai Lan (Chinese Broccoli)
items.desc: gai lan consists of thick, dark green stems topped with broad, glossy leaves and small, tightly closed white or yellow flowerets. the stems are crunchy and substantial, thicker than typical broccoli florets but more tender than a full broccoli stalk. its appearance is somewhat akin to a leafy broccoli rabe but with thicker stems and less bitterness.

items.name: Gala Apples, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: large gala apples are robust, with a conical to heart shape, significantly bigger than their small counterparts. they feature a smooth, thin skin with a distinct stripey blush of red and orange over a yellow base. these apples are substantial, requiring two hands for a comfortable grip for some.

items.name: Gala Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: showing distinctive orange-red vertical stripes over golden-yellow base, round shape, warm-toned striping pattern, mild sheen

items.name: Gala Apples, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: showing distinctive orange-red vertical stripes over golden-yellow base, round shape, warm-toned striping pattern, mild sheen

items.name: Gala Apples, Small (West)
items.desc: small gala apples have a conical to heart shape, often smaller than average apples. their skin is smooth, thin, and brightly colored with a characteristic stripey blush of red and orange over a yellow background. they are firm and fit comfortably in the palm of a small hand.

items.name: Galangal Root
items.desc: galangal root is a gnarled, knobbed rhizome with a tough, woody exterior, typically light brown to pale pinkish-brown, often with visible rings. its flesh is white to pale yellow and fibrous. it resembles ginger but is generally larger, paler, and has a smoother, less bumpy skin.

items.name: Galia Melon
items.desc: this melon has a distinctive golden-yellow rind covered in fine, intricate netting when ripe. it is typically spherical to slightly oval in shape. the interior flesh is pale green to white, very aromatic, and has a sweet, refreshing taste. it generally weighs between 2-4 pounds.

items.name: Garlic
items.desc: showing white papery skin, round bulb of multiple cloves, pointed top

items.name: Garlic - Fresh with Leaves
items.desc: characterized by its long, green, flat, strap-like leaves attached to a tender, pale green or purplish-white stem that gradually thickens towards the base, forming an immature bulb. unlike dried garlic, the cloves are not fully formed or separated, and the entire plant resembles a leek or thick green onion. the bulbous base is relatively small and soft.

items.name: Garlic - One-clove types
items.desc: these garlic bulbs are unique in that they contain only a single, large clove, rather than multiple smaller cloves. they are typically spherical or slightly ovate, with a smooth, firm, papery white to off-white skin. their uniform, round shape distinguishes them from regular garlic which has a segmented appearance.

items.name: Garlic - Regular - Smoked
items.desc: regular smoked garlic bulbs are typically off-white to light brown, with a papery skin that often shows a slight golden or yellowish tint from the smoking process. the cloves are arranged in a classic bulb shape, firm to the touch, and emit a distinct smoky aroma. visually, they resemble regular garlic but often have slightly darker, more brittle skin and a characteristic smoky scent.

items.name: Garlic - String
items.desc: a decorative garlic braid — 8-10 whole white garlic bulbs with their dried stems braided together into a hanging rope or plait. the bulbs hang vertically in a chain formation with the braided stems connecting them.

items.name: Garlic Chives
items.desc: long, flat, grass-like green leaves, notably broader and flatter than common chives, typically sold in small bunches. they possess a distinct pungent garlic-like aroma and flavor, making them visually and olfactorily distinct from onion-flavored chives.

items.name: Gem Squash
items.desc: a small, round, and dark green squash, typically 3-4 inches in diameter, with a hard, smooth rind. it resembles a small watermelon or a very dark green acorn squash without the prominent ridges.

items.name: Ginger Gold Apples, Large
items.desc: showing pale golden-yellow color, round shape, thin skin, smooth appearance

items.name: Ginger Gold Apples, Small
items.desc: showing pale golden-yellow color, round shape, thin skin, smooth appearance

items.name: Ginger Root
items.desc: showing tan beige knobby branching irregular shape, aromatic root

items.name: Gloster Apples - Large
items.desc: these are large gloster apples, characterized by their distinctly conical shape with prominent ribs towards the base. the smooth skin is predominantly a deep, dark red, often with lighter green-yellow undertones visible where the red is less intense. they have a waxy feel and a firm texture, appearing significantly larger than the 'small' variant of gloster apples.

items.name: Gloster Apples - Small

items.name: Japanese White Cucumber
items.desc: a medium-sized, straight, slender cucumber, typically 6-10 inches long. its skin is a very pale green or almost white, smooth, and slightly ribbed, distinguishing it from common dark green varieties.

items.name: Jazz Apples, Large
items.desc: showing red-maroon flush over green-gold, round dense compact shape, deep saturated red

items.name: Jazz Apples, Small
items.desc: showing red-maroon flush over green-gold, round dense compact shape, deep saturated red

items.name: Jicama
items.desc: showing large round flat globe, tan papery skin

items.name: Jonagold Apples, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: large jonagold apples are notably sizable and round-conical, much larger than average apples. their skin features a striking mosaic of mottled bright red and orange blushes over a sunny yellow-green base, often displaying prominent lenticels. these apples are substantial, firm, and have a beautiful bi-colored appearance.

items.name: Jonagold Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: showing orange-red blush over greenish-yellow, large round-conical shape

items.name: Jonagold Apples, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: showing orange-red blush over greenish-yellow, large round-conical shape

items.name: Jonagold Apples, Small (West)
items.desc: small jonagold apples are typically large for a small apple, with a round-conical shape. their skin is a distinctive blend of mottled bright red and orange over a yellow-green background, creating a visually appealing, somewhat speckled appearance. they are firm and weighty for their size, fitting well in a smaller hand.

items.name: Jonamac Apples - Large
items.desc: large jonamac apples are round to slightly flattened, significantly bigger than their small counterparts. they boast a vibrant, almost entirely deep red skin, occasionally revealing flecks of green or yellow. the skin is smooth and firm, making these apples visually striking and substantial.

items.name: Jonamac Apples - Small
items.desc: small jonamac apples are typically round to slightly flattened, displaying a deep, solid red blush that often covers most of their surface, sometimes with hints of green or yellow showing through. their skin is smooth and relatively thin. these apples are compact and have a fresh, crisp appearance.

items.name: Jonathan Apples, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: showing bright medium red with some yellow-green at base, round shape, thinner skin

items.name: Jonathan Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: large-sized, bright, classic red apple with occasional hints of green or yellow near the stem or base. it has a smooth, shiny skin and a round to slightly conical shape, often with subtle vertical ribbing. firm texture.

items.name: Jonathan Apples, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: showing bright medium red with some yellow-green at base, round shape, thinner skin

items.name: Jonathan Apples, Small (West)
items.desc: small jonathan apples are round to slightly conical, showcasing a vibrant, solid crimson red skin that sometimes has a lighter red blush or subtle green undertones. their skin is glossy and smooth, sometimes with faint vertical stripes visible. these are compact, firm apples known for their classic tart-sweet flavor.

items.name: Juice Oranges
items.desc: showing thin-skinned orange, may appear blemished, labeled as juice grade

items.name: Juici™ Apples
items.desc: juici™ apples are medium to large, generally round to conical. they boast a striking bright red skin, often with a streaky pattern over a yellow-green background, giving them a glossy appearance. the skin is smooth, relatively thin, and may show small, light lenticels.

items.name: Jumbo Pumpkin
items.desc: exceptionally large and heavy, with a classic rounded or slightly flattened shape. the skin is a vibrant, uniform orange, typically smooth with deep, prominent vertical ribs. it often has a thick, sturdy green stem.

items.name: Jupiter Grapes
items.desc: jupiter grapes shown as a full cluster/bunch hanging on stems, large oval deep red-purple to black-purple seedless grapes, notably bigger berries than standard table grapes, slight dusty bloom on surface, multiple grapes visible in a compact bunch on a stem, muscat-like variety known for very large berries

items.name: Kabocha Squash
items.desc: showing squat round shape, dark green with pale green stripes, hard skin

items.name: Kale Sprouts
items.desc: kale sprouts are tiny, vibrant green leaves with delicate stems, typically less than an inch long. they have the characteristic ruffled edges of mature kale but are much smaller and more tender. they are usually sold in small plastic clamshells.

items.name: Kale, Curly
items.desc: natural appearance, accurate to real produce variety

items.name: Kale, Red/Multicolor
items.desc: natural appearance, accurate to real produce variety

items.name: Karma Apples
items.desc: karma apples are medium-sized, round to slightly conical. their skin is a deep, glossy red, often with small, pale lenticels, and can have subtle yellow or green streaks near the stem. the surface is smooth and firm.

items.name: Key Limes
items.desc: very small golf-ball size, yellower-green than persian limes, round, thin skin

items.name: King Royal Pears
items.desc: king royal pears display a classic pear shape, featuring a well-defined neck that gracefully expands into a rounded base. the skin is characteristically a bright golden-yellow, often adorned with a delicate reddish blush on one side where it receives more sun. its flesh is celebrated for being exceptionally sweet, juicy, and having a remarkably smooth texture.

items.name: Kinnow Mandarins
items.desc: showing yellowish-orange, tight thin skin, medium size

items.name: Kiwifruit
items.desc: showing whole small oval egg-shaped fruit with brown fuzzy skin, with a cut half laid perpendicular beside it revealing bright green flesh with tiny black seeds

items.name: Kiwifruit - Jumbo
items.desc: showing whole large oval fruit with fuzzy dull brown skin, significantly bigger than standard kiwis, with a cut half laid perpendicular beside it revealing bright green flesh with tiny black seeds in a ring around a lighter core.

items.name: Kohlrabi
items.desc: a round, bulbous vegetable, typically 2-4 inches in diameter, resembling a turnip growing above ground. it has a pale green or purple skin, with leafy stems protruding directly from the globe, often giving it a sputnik-like appearance. the texture is firm and crunchy, with a mild, slightly sweet, peppery flavor.

items.name: Kohlrabi - Purple/Red
items.desc: kohlrabi is a unique, bulbous vegetable with a pale green or purple skin, resembling a spaceship or an alien turnip. it has a rounded, swollen stem that grows above ground, with leafy stems protruding from its sides. the interior is crisp, white, and juicy, tasting like a mild broccoli stem or cabbage heart.

items.name: Korean Melon
items.desc: small, oblong, bright yellow melon with distinct white ridges running lengthwise along its smooth, thin, edible skin. the flesh is pale white, crisp, and sweet, with a small central seed cavity. it lacks the netting or rough texture of other melon varieties.

items.name: Kumquats
items.desc: very small olive-sized, bright orange, oval oblong shape, edible rind

items.name: Lady Apples
items.desc: lady apples are very small, almost bite-sized, with a flattened, round shape. their skin is typically a vibrant, rosy red blush over a bright yellow-green base. they are distinguished by their petite size, often no larger than a golf ball, and their delicate, slightly flattened appearance.

items.name: Lady Williams Apples
items.desc: small to medium-sized, somewhat conical apples with a firm, greenish-yellow skin extensively flushed and striped with a bright red blush. they often have visible, small white speckles (lenticels) and a very crisp, juicy flesh that improves in flavor with storage.

items.name: Laxtons Fortune Apples
items.desc: these are medium-sized, round to slightly flattened apples with a smooth, firm skin. the base color is a vibrant golden-yellow, extensively adorned with distinct bright orange-red stripes and flushes, sometimes creating an almost entirely red appearance on one side. they possess a sweet aroma and a crisp texture.

items.name: Leeks
items.desc: showing long thick white and green stalk, flat dark green leaves at top, no bulb

items.name: Leeks - Baby
items.desc: slender, elongated vegetables with a small, slightly bulged white base transitioning to pale green, then dark green leafy tops. baby leeks are typically thinner, around 0.5 to 1 inch in diameter, and shorter than standard leeks, usually 6-10 inches in length. they have a delicate, onion-like flavor.

items.name: Leeks - Baby - Bunch
items.desc: baby leeks are miniature versions of regular leeks, exhibiting the same cylindrical shape and color gradient from white to dark green, but significantly smaller and more slender. they are often sold in bunches, looking like delicate, pencil-thin versions of their mature counterparts. their texture is more tender, and the white base is shorter, making them appear more uniformly green overall compared to regular leeks.

items.name: Leeks - Regular - Bunch
items.desc: regular leeks are long, cylindrical vegetables with a thick white base transitioning to pale green, then dark green leafy tops. they are typically sold in bunches, with multiple stalks tied together. the texture is firm and crisp, with distinct layers of overlapping leaves forming the stalk. the root end is usually trimmed, leaving a small, clean white base.

items.name: Lemon Cucumber
items.desc: a small, round or oval-shaped cucumber, about the size of a tennis ball. it has a bright yellow skin, similar in color to a lemon, sometimes with slight green striations or a faint fuzz.

items.name: Lemonade Apples - Large
items.desc: a large, round apple with a bright, luminous yellow-green skin, reminiscent of a lemon's color, sometimes with a faint blush. it has an exceptionally crisp texture and a distinctively tart, zesty flavor that mellows to sweet, and is noticeably larger than average.

items.name: Lemonade Apples - Small
items.desc: a small, round apple with a bright, luminous yellow-green skin, reminiscent of a lemon's color, sometimes with a faint blush. it has an exceptionally crisp texture and a distinctively tart, zesty flavor that mellows to sweet, and is noticeably smaller than average.

items.name: Lemongrass
items.desc: long, thick, pale green stalks resembling a stiff, woody spring onion. the base is whitish to light green and bulbous, tapering into tough, fibrous green blades. it has a distinctive citrusy aroma and a layered texture, similar to a very large, firm scallion or a leek stalk, but much stiffer.

items.name: Lemons - Without postharvest treatment
items.desc: these lemons exhibit a vibrant, matte yellow skin that lacks the typical high shine of waxed lemons, often appearing slightly duller or with natural variations. they retain the classic oval shape and distinct pointed ends of lemons, but their peel might feel a bit rougher or more textured due to the absence of artificial coatings. their size is typical for lemons, ranging from small to medium.

items.name: Lemons, Large
items.desc: showing bright yellow, oval with pointed ends, textured bumpy skin

items.name: Lemons, Medium
items.desc: showing bright yellow, oval with pointed ends, textured bumpy skin

items.name: Lemons, Small
items.desc: showing bright yellow, oval with pointed ends, textured bumpy skin

items.name: Lettuce - Bibb/Flat/Round
items.desc: a type of loose-leaf lettuce forming a moderately compact, round head, approximately 4-6 inches in diameter. the leaves are typically bright to medium green, tender, and somewhat crinkled or ruffled, with a slightly buttery texture and mild, sweet flavor. it's less dense than iceberg lettuce and not as elongated as romaine.

items.name: Lettuce - Boston, Red
items.desc: loose, soft, buttery leaves forming a round, delicate head. the leaves are typically a deep green at the base, transitioning to a striking reddish-bronze or purplish hue towards the edges. it has a tender texture and a mild, sweet flavor.

items.name: Lettuce - Boston/Butter
items.desc: forms a loose, tender head of smooth, soft leaves that range from light green to a deeper green, often with a slight yellow tint towards the core. the leaves have a distinctive buttery texture and a delicate, sweet flavor. typically larger than bibb lettuce, with a more open structure, usually 6-8 inches across.

items.name: Lettuce - Catalogna
items.desc: long, slender, deeply serrated dark green leaves that grow upright from a central root. the leaves are firm, somewhat fibrous, and possess a distinct bitter flavor, often mellowing when cooked.

items.name: Lettuce - Hydroponic
items.desc: various types of lettuce grown without soil, often sold with its root ball attached to maintain freshness. visually, it can resemble loose-leaf, butter, or romaine varieties, typically vibrant green, with clean, crisp leaves and an intact white root structure. the leaves are generally free of soil residue and often more uniform in appearance.

items.name: Lettuce - Iceberg
items.desc: a large, dense, spherical head of light green leaves, tightly overlapping. the outer leaves are slightly darker green, fading to a pale, almost white core. leaves are crisp and brittle with a mild flavor.

items.name: Lettuce - Lollo Bionda
items.desc: a loose-leaf lettuce characterized by its bright, vibrant green color and dense, frilly, curled leaves that form a compact, wavy head. the leaves have a delicate, slightly crinkled texture, providing good volume and visual appeal. it lacks a firm, central heart.

items.name: Lettuce - Lollo Rossa
items.desc: a striking loose-leaf lettuce with deeply frilled, curled leaves that transition from a bright green base to a rich reddish-bronze or purplish-red at the edges. it forms a voluminous, wavy head without a tight heart. the texture of the leaves is delicate and soft.

items.name: Lettuce - Mache
items.desc: small, delicate clusters of spoon-shaped, dark green leaves. the leaves are smooth, tender, and somewhat fleshy, forming a rosette. it has a slightly nutty and sweet flavor, often sold in small bags or clamshells.

items.name: Lettuce - Mignonette
items.desc: a small, compact butterhead lettuce with a loosely formed head. its soft, tender leaves are predominantly green, but feature distinctive reddish or purplish tints along the edges and tips. the leaves are smooth and delicate, characteristic of butterhead varieties.

items.name: Lettuce - Mixed Small-Leaf Salad
items.desc: a vibrant assortment of small, tender leafy greens, typically including various young lettuces, arugula, and other delicate leaves. colors range from light green to dark green, often with reddish or purplish hues. the leaves vary in shape from smooth to slightly frilly, offering a diverse visual and textual mix.

items.name: Lettuce - Oak Leaf - Green
items.desc: a loose-leaf lettuce characterized by its deeply lobed leaves that distinctly resemble oak tree leaves, with an even, vibrant green color throughout. the leaves are soft and tender, forming a moderately loose, open head. its distinct shape makes it easily recognizable.

items.name: Lettuce - Romaine, Red
items.desc: long, upright, slightly crinkled leaves forming an elongated head. the leaves transition from a deep green base to a rich reddish-purple or burgundy color at the tips and margins. it has a crisp texture and a slightly bitter, peppery flavor.

items.name: Lima Beans
items.desc: lima beans are short, flat, crescent-shaped pods, usually 3-5 inches long and plump, with a smooth, bright green skin. inside, they contain several large, flat, kidney-shaped beans that are typically light green or cream-colored. the pods have a distinct ridge along one side.

items.name: Lima Oranges
items.desc: lima oranges are medium-sized, round to slightly oblate citrus fruits with a smooth, bright orange rind that is easy to peel. they often have a slightly flattened bottom. their flesh is a bright orange, very juicy, and notably sweet with very low acidity.

items.name: Limequats
items.desc: these are small, oval-shaped hybrid citrus fruits, typically 1 to 2 inches in length. they have a thin, smooth, and entirely edible rind that is bright yellow-green. the flesh is pale yellow, very juicy, and combines tartness with a pleasant sweetness, often eaten whole.

items.name: Limes
items.desc: showing bright green, oval-round shape, smooth thin skin, persian/tahiti variety

items.name: Lochbuie Apples
items.desc: lochbuie apples are medium to large, round-conical fruits. their skin is mostly covered in a dark, dull red blush with some darker striping over a greenish-yellow base, often with a slightly waxy feel. the flesh is firm, greenish-white, and quite tart.

items.name: Loganberries
items.desc: showing dark red-purple, elongated, raspberry-blackberry hybrid

items.name: Lolipop® Apples
items.desc: lolipop® apples, also known as inored, are characterized by their very intense, deep ruby-red skin that almost entirely covers the fruit, sometimes with faint darker streaks. they are medium-sized, very round, and have a smooth, firm skin. the consistent deep red hue is a key visual identifier.

items.name: Long Hot Pepper, Green
items.desc: long thin pepper, green to red, twisted wrinkled shape

items.name: Long Hot Red Peppers
items.desc: elongated, slender peppers, generally 6-8 inches in length, with a smooth, firm, and glossy bright red skin. they maintain a slightly curved shape, tapering to a pointed tip, and possess a moderately thick flesh. the color is consistently vivid across the pepper's surface.

items.name: Long-stemmed Strawberries
items.desc: showing 3 premium extra-large deep red strawberries, each with an unusually long green stem (3-5 inches of stem), glossy blemish-free surface, arranged standing upright to showcase the long stems

items.name: Longan
items.desc: showing very small tan-brown thin shell, round fruit

items.name: Loquats
items.desc: small, oval to round fruit, typically 3-5 cm long, with smooth or slightly downy, yellowish-orange skin. the skin is thin and easily peeled. the flesh is juicy, sweet-tart, and ranges from white to orange, containing large brown seeds.

items.name: Lord Lambourne Apples
items.desc: a medium-sized, somewhat flattened-round apple with a smooth, slightly waxy skin. the underlying color is a pale green-yellow, almost entirely covered by a rich, deep red flush that can appear nearly solid dark red. this red often has faint darker stripes or mottling, giving it a velvety appearance. it feels dense and firm.

items.name: Lotus Root
items.desc: an elongated, segmented tuber with a light brown, slightly rough skin that can be peeled to reveal creamy-white flesh. when sliced crosswise, it displays a unique, intricate pattern of symmetrical air pockets arranged in a circular design. it has a crisp texture and a starchy, subtly sweet flavor.

items.name: LucyGlo Apples
items.desc: lucyglo apples are medium to large and round, similar to lucyrose but often with a slightly more elongated shape. their skin is a bright, shiny red with a noticeable waxy coating. like lucyrose, they possess attractive pink-red flesh, which is often visible as a 'glow' through the skin in lighter areas. the skin is firm and smooth.

items.name: LucyRose Apples
items.desc: lucyrose apples are medium-sized and round. their skin is a striking, deep glossy red, sometimes with a slight purplish hue. the most distinguishing feature is their bright pinkish-red flesh, visible when cut. the skin is smooth and firm.

items.name: Ludacrisp Apples
items.desc: ludacrisp apples are medium to large with a conical shape, featuring a distinctive bi-color skin of vibrant red blush over a yellow-green background. the skin often has a slightly rustic or textured feel. they are known for a very firm, crunchy flesh and a pronounced stem cavity.

items.name: Lychees
items.desc: small, round to oval fruit, about 2-3 cm in diameter, encased in a thin, bumpy, red or pinkish-red rind. the rind is easily peeled, revealing a translucent white, juicy, and fragrant flesh. a single, large, dark brown seed is typically found at the center.

items.name: Madroña
items.desc: madroña fruits are small, spherical berries, typically 1-2 cm in diameter, covered in a coarse, warty, bright red to orange-red skin when ripe. they possess a slightly rough, granular surface texture, resembling a miniature lychee or rambutan. the flesh inside is soft, somewhat mealy, and offers a mildly sweet flavor.

items.name: Magic Star Apples
items.desc: magic star apples are medium to large with a round to slightly conical shape. they exhibit a brilliant, intense red blush over a yellow background, often with visible striations or lenticels. the skin is smooth and waxy.

items.name: Malanga
items.desc: a thick, tuberous root vegetable with a rough, brown, hairy exterior, resembling a gnarled potato or taro. the skin can be light to dark brown and is often covered in fibrous hairs. internally, the flesh is firm and can be white, yellow, or pinkish, with a texture similar to potato or yam. it is typically oblong or irregular in shape.

items.name: Mamey
items.desc: a single whole mamey sapote — large oval fruit about the size and shape of a football, 10-25 cm long. rough, russet-brown leathery exterior skin with a slightly sandpaper texture, small dried stem nub at one end. show the whole uncut fruit only — no cross-section, no cut open view, exterior only.

items.name: Mango - Green (Keitt/Francis) - Extra Large
items.desc: this extra-large mango features a vibrant, dull green skin, even when ripe, with minimal to no blush. it has an oval to elongated shape and a smooth, firm surface. the size is notably larger than typical mangoes.

items.name: Mango - Green (Large)
items.desc: an oval-to-oblong shaped fruit, primarily solid green or with very minimal blush, even when ripe. the skin is smooth and relatively thin. this is a large mango, typically weighing over a pound, with firm flesh that can be slightly tart when less ripe.

items.name: Mango - Green (Small)
items.desc: small, oval to oblong fruit, typically 8-10 cm long, with a firm, uniformly green skin that may have a slight blush. the skin is smooth and unyielding to touch. when ripe, the flesh is still firm, less sweet than yellow mangoes, and can be pale yellow to greenish-orange, often used for savory dishes.

items.name: Mango - Kensington Pride (Bowen)
items.desc: this mango variety is medium-sized, typically oval to kidney-shaped with a relatively flat profile. its skin ripens to a beautiful yellow-orange with a blush of pink or red, often showing small green patches even when ripe. the texture is smooth, and the fruit feels firm but yields slightly when ripe, indicating readiness.

items.name: Mango - R2E2
items.desc: r2e2 mangoes are large, round to ovate fruits with a distinct yellow-orange skin often covered by a prominent red blush across much of its surface. they have a firm, smooth skin texture, even when ripe, and maintain a symmetrical, full shape. the overall appearance is robust and vividly colored, making them visually striking.

items.name: Mango - Ripe/Ready-to-Eat
items.desc: these mangos are selected and ripened to a soft, yielding texture, often with a rich, aromatic fragrance. their skin color will typically be fully developed for their variety, usually a vibrant yellow, orange, or a deep red blush, with minimal green patches. they feel slightly soft to the touch, indicating optimal ripeness, and often have a more pronounced tropical scent.

items.name: Mango - Yellow (Small)
items.desc: small, elongated, kidney-shaped fruit, typically 8-10 cm long, with a thin, smooth, golden-yellow skin. the skin is slightly wrinkled when very ripe. the flesh is very sweet, non-fibrous, buttery-smooth, and deep yellow-orange, clinging tightly to a small, flat pit.

items.name: Mangoes, Red, Extra Large
items.desc: a single extra-large red variety mango, predominantly deep red skin blushed across most of the surface with yellow-green near the base, very large oval shape — the biggest mango available, smooth waxy skin, small stem nub at top.

items.name: Mangoes, Red, Large
items.desc: a single large red variety mango (tommy atkins or kent), predominantly bright crimson-red skin blushed across most of the surface with some yellow-green near the base, large oval shape weighing over 1 lb, smooth waxy skin, small stem nub at top.

items.name: Mangoes, Red, Small
items.desc: a single small red variety mango, predominantly red skin with yellow-green areas near the base, compact oval shape, noticeably smaller than a large mango, smooth waxy skin, small stem nub at top.

items.name: Mangoes, Yellow, Large
items.desc: showing smaller kidney-shaped golden-yellow mango, smooth bright yellow skin, ataulfo variety, no red blush

items.name: Mangosteen
items.desc: showing oval fruit with red-green-yellow multi-colored skin gradient, smooth skin

items.name: Mariri Red Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round to slightly conical apple. it boasts a very intense, deep ruby-red color that covers almost the entire fruit, sometimes appearing almost blackish-red in certain areas. the skin is smooth and may have faint lenticels visible.

items.name: Marjoram
items.desc: small, oval, velvety soft leaves that are grey-green in color, growing on slender stems. the leaves are typically clustered tightly along the stems and have a slightly fuzzy texture. it's often mistaken for oregano, but marjoram leaves are generally smaller, rounder, and softer with a milder, sweeter aroma.

items.name: Maui Onion
items.desc: showing pale yellow to white large flat sweet onion, hawaiian variety

items.name: Mayan Melon
items.desc: the mayan melon has an elongated, football-like shape with a light green rind that may have subtle ribbing and faint speckles. its flesh is a distinct creamy orange, offering a sweet and firm texture. this melon stands out with its unusual form and unique internal color.

items.name: McIntosh Apples, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: showing dark red with distinct green patches, two-tone appearance, round slightly flattened shape, thin tender skin

items.name: McIntosh Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: large-sized, round apple with a vibrant red blush over a green or greenish-yellow background, often displaying a powdery bloom. its skin is thin and tender, sometimes with visible lenticels. it has a slightly irregular, often somewhat flattened shape.

items.name: McIntosh Apples, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: showing dark red with distinct green patches, two-tone appearance, round slightly flattened shape, thin tender skin

items.name: McIntosh Apples, Small (West)
items.desc: small-sized, round apple with a vibrant red blush over a green or greenish-yellow background, often displaying a powdery bloom. its skin is thin and tender, sometimes with visible lenticels. it has a slightly irregular, often somewhat flattened shape.

items.name: Melogold Grapefruit
items.desc: showing pale yellow-green, slightly flattened, thinner rind than oro blanco

items.name: Melon - Glasshouse - Netted varieties
items.desc: these melons exhibit a distinct, prominent netting pattern across their surface, characteristic of varieties like cantaloupe grown in controlled glasshouse environments. the skin color beneath the netting is typically a muted green, yellow-green, or pale gold, offering a subtle contrast to the raised texture. they are generally round to slightly oval, with a firm feel beneath the raised netting.

items.name: Melon - Gold Honeydew
items.desc: a round to slightly oval melon with a smooth, firm rind that ripens from a pale yellow to a vibrant golden-yellow color. the interior flesh is typically a pale green, similar to traditional honeydew, but with a sweeter, more aromatic flavor. it has a slightly waxy feel and no netting.

items.name: Melon - Ogen
items.desc: ogen melons are medium-sized, round to slightly flattened melons with a strikingly smooth, pale yellow or greenish-yellow skin. they are characterized by distinct, dark green vertical sutures or stripes running from top to bottom, which become more pronounced as the fruit ripens. the surface is not netted and has a delicate, almost velvety feel.

items.name: Melon - Piel de Sapo
items.desc: an oval-shaped melon with a distinctive thick, hard rind that is mottled and wrinkled, resembling a frog's skin. the rind is dark green with irregular lighter green or yellow patches. the interior flesh is pale green to white, juicy, and very sweet with a mild aroma.

items.name: Meyer Lemons
items.desc: showing rounder shape than regular lemon, deeper golden-orange hue, thinner smoother skin

items.name: Michaelmas Red Apples
items.desc: a small to medium-sized, round-conical apple with a very smooth, often shiny skin. the fruit is almost entirely covered by a vibrant, deep crimson-red flush, sometimes appearing purple-red, with only faint hints of green visible near the stem or calyx. its flesh is crisp and aromatic, and the skin often feels slightly waxy.

items.name: Mickey Lee Watermelon
items.desc: showing whole small nearly spherical watermelon with very dark green, almost black, smooth rind lacking prominent stripes, with a cut wedge laid beside it revealing bright red crisp flesh with small dark seeds. an icebox variety.

items.name: Midknight Orange - Small
items.desc: a seedless navel-type orange with a bright orange, smooth, thin skin that is easy to peel. the fruit is typically round to slightly oval and contains a rich, sweet, and very juicy pulp. as a "small" variant, it would be noticeably smaller than average oranges, possibly 2-2.5 inches in diameter, but still firm and brightly colored.

items.name: Midknight Oranges - Large
items.desc: these are large midknight oranges, distinguished by their substantial size, making them considerably larger than the medium variety and filling an adult's hand. they possess a bright, deep orange, smooth to slightly textured peel that is relatively thin. their shape is typically round or slightly oval, indicating their high juice content.

items.name: Midknight Oranges - Medium
items.desc: midknight oranges are known for their juiciness and rich, sweet flavor. these medium-sized oranges have a bright orange, relatively smooth peel that is somewhat thin and often slightly adheres to the flesh. they typically have a round to slightly oval shape, fitting well in the palm of a hand.

items.name: Midnight Beauty Grapes
items.desc: midnight beauty grapes are medium to large, uniformly oval-shaped, with a deep, glossy, almost black skin. they are typically firm and plump, growing in tight clusters on green stems. their dark, consistent color and elongated shape distinguish them from lighter varieties.

items.name: Migo™ Pears
items.desc: migo pears are medium to large in size, characterized by their smooth, bright green skin that ripens to a golden-yellow. they have a classic pyriform pear shape, tapering towards the stem, and feel firm to the touch.

items.name: Milwa Apples
items.desc: milwa apples are typically medium-sized, roundish, with a significant red blush over a yellow-green background. the skin is smooth and may have small lenticels. they offer a balanced sweet-tart flavor with a crisp texture.

items.name: Mini Watermelon
items.desc: showing whole small personal-sized watermelon with dark green rind, with a cut wedge laid beside it revealing bright red seedless flesh

items.name: Mini White Pumpkin
items.desc: small, typically palm-sized, with a smooth, bright white to creamy white skin. it has the classic pumpkin shape with gentle vertical ribs and a short, stout green stem. its miniature size is its primary distinguishing feature compared to larger white pumpkins.

items.name: Minneola Tangelos
items.desc: showing deep reddish-orange, distinctive knob at stem end creating bell shape, smooth skin

items.name: Minnewashta (Zestar) Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round to slightly conical apple with a crisp, juicy texture. its skin features a vibrant red blush, often streaked, over a pale green or yellow background. the surface is smooth, sometimes with visible lenticels.

items.name: Mint
items.desc: showing small oval serrated bright green leaves, square stems

items.name: Morel Mushrooms
items.desc: showing brown honeycomb-pitted conical cap, hollow inside, distinctive sponge-like texture

items.name: Morita Chili Peppers
items.desc: small to medium-sized, somewhat plump peppers, 2-3 inches long, with a rounded shoulder tapering to a blunt or slightly pointed tip. they are characterized by a deep, dark red to reddish-brown color with a somewhat matte, slightly wrinkled appearance, indicative of a very ripe or partially dried state. the skin is typically firm but can be subtly creased.

items.name: Mushrooms - Cep
items.desc: cep mushrooms have a distinctive thick, often bulbous stem that is lighter in color than its cap, ranging from off-white to light brown with fine reticulations. the cap is broad, convex, and typically rich brown, sometimes reddish-brown, with a slightly sticky or velvety texture. they have pores underneath the cap instead of gills, which are off-white when young, yellow-green when mature.

items.name: Mushrooms - Fairy Ring Champignon
items.desc: these small, delicate mushrooms feature a bell-shaped to convex cap, typically buff to tan or reddish-brown when moist, fading to a pale cream or off-white when dry. the cap can often have a slightly wrinkled margin. they have thin, widely spaced gills that are cream-colored, and a slender, tough stem that is usually paler than the cap and can be fibrous.

items.name: Mushrooms - Grey - Tricholoma
items.desc: grey tricholoma mushrooms typically have a distinctive conical to broadly convex cap that is dark grey to grey-brown, often with darker radiating fibrils and a greasy or slimy texture when wet. the gills underneath are white to pale grey, notched, and quite dense. the stem is usually white or pale grey, solid, and can sometimes be slightly swollen at the base.

items.name: Mushrooms - Grisette
items.desc: grisette mushrooms are characterized by their smooth, dome-shaped to flattened cap, which is typically grey to brownish-grey, often with striations along the margin. they possess distinctive white, free gills that do not attach to the stem, and a slender, fragile stem that is white or grayish. a key feature is the presence of a sac-like volva at the base of the stem, often partially or fully buried, and the absence of a ring.

items.name: Mushrooms - Horn of Plenty/Black Trumpet
items.desc: horn of plenty mushrooms are uniquely shaped like a trumpet or horn, funneling downwards. they are dark grey to black, with a velvety or finely scaled texture on the outer surface and a smoother, hollow interior. they lack distinct gills, having a wrinkled or veined surface on the underside of the cap. their overall appearance is distinctly dark and hollow.

items.name: Mushrooms - Pioppino
items.desc: pioppino mushrooms grow in clusters, featuring small to medium-sized convex caps that are typically dark brown, smooth, and slightly slimy when wet, often with a paler margin. they have crowded, pale yellow-brown gills that darken with age. the stems are slender, firm, and usually off-white to light brown, often darker towards the base, with a small ring that may be present or absent.

items.name: Musk Melon
items.desc: showing netted rind similar to cantaloupe, strong musky aroma, round shape

items.name: Mustard Greens
items.desc: showing bright green frilly peppery leaves, lighter green than collards

items.name: Napa Cabbage
items.desc: showing tall cylindrical shape, pale green-white crinkled leaves, chinese cabbage

items.name: Navel Oranges, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: a large, spherical to slightly oval citrus fruit with a prominent 'navel' at one end. its thick, vibrant orange rind is relatively easy to peel and has a textured surface. the seedless, sweet, and juicy flesh is segmented within, making it ideal for eating fresh. this size is considerably larger than typical navel oranges.

items.name: Navel Oranges, Large (West)
items.desc: large navel orange in pure equatorial side view — showing only the round orange midsection, no stem end visible, no blossom end or navel dimple visible, just the round side profile, bright vibrant orange thick bumpy peel, perfectly circular silhouette

items.name: Navel Oranges, Medium
items.desc: medium navel orange in pure equatorial side view — showing only the round orange midsection, no stem end visible, no blossom end or navel dimple visible, bright vibrant orange bumpy peel, perfectly circular silhouette, noticeably smaller than a large navel orange

items.name: Navel Oranges, Small (East/Central)
items.desc: this small, bright orange citrus fruit is characterized by a distinctive 'navel' or indentation at one end, which is actually a small rudimentary second fruit. it has a slightly bumpy, easy-to-peel skin and a sweet, juicy, seedless flesh. its size is notably smaller than standard navel oranges.

items.name: Navel Oranges, Small (West)
items.desc: small navel orange in pure equatorial side view — showing only the round orange midsection, no stem end visible, no blossom end or navel dimple visible, bright vibrant orange bumpy peel, perfectly circular silhouette, compact small size

items.name: Nectarine - Nectavigne (Red Flesh)
items.desc: this nectarine variety is characterized by its smooth, vibrant red skin, often with patches of yellow or orange, and notably, a distinctive deep red or purplish-red flesh inside. it has the typical round to slightly heart-shaped form of a nectarine. the skin is taut and hairless, providing a stark contrast to the unusual interior flesh color which is visible when cut.

items.name: Nectarine - Yellow Flesh, Large
items.desc: this large stone fruit has a smooth, fuzz-free skin that typically ranges from a vibrant red blush over a yellow-orange background. its flesh is firm, juicy, and bright yellow, surrounding a central pit. the shape is round to slightly heart-shaped, similar to a peach but without the fuzzy skin.

items.name: Nectarine - Yellow Flesh, Tree Ripened, Ready-to-eat - Small
items.desc: a small, smooth-skinned stone fruit with a firm yet yielding texture, indicative of ripeness. the skin is typically a vibrant red blush over a golden-yellow base, with no fuzz. when cut, it reveals juicy, sweet yellow flesh surrounding a central pit.

items.name: Nectarines, White
items.desc: showing smooth pale skin with red blush, like a peach but with smooth glossy skin

items.name: Nectarines, Yellow, Large
items.desc: showing smooth glossy red-and-yellow skin, like a peach but without fuzz

items.name: Nectarines, Yellow, Small
items.desc: showing smooth glossy red-and-yellow skin, like a peach but without fuzz

items.name: Negro Peppers
items.desc: long, slender peppers, 6-10 inches in length, distinguished by their unique dark purplish-black color that can appear almost black. they often have a slightly wrinkled surface with a subtle sheen and a gently tapered, sometimes slightly twisted shape. the skin is relatively thin.

items.name: New Mexico Pepper
items.desc: long 6-8 inch pepper, green, smooth elongated shape, similar to anaheim but larger

items.name: New Zealand Spinach
items.desc: new zealand spinach has small to medium-sized, fleshy, triangular or spade-shaped leaves, typically dark green. unlike common spinach, its leaves are thicker and succulent, often with a slightly fuzzy or waxy texture. it grows on spreading stems, and is usually sold as loose leaves or small bunches, distinguished by its unique leaf shape and robust texture.

items.name: Nicogreen Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round to slightly conical apple with a uniformly bright, vibrant green skin. the skin is smooth and glossy, often with very subtle light lenticels. it retains its green color even when fully ripe and has a crisp texture.

items.name: Nicoter Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round-conical apple with a bright, glossy appearance. the skin is a distinctive two-tone, featuring a vibrant red blush over a sunny yellow or green base, often with subtle streaking. it has a crisp texture and a small, sturdy stem.

items.name: Noble Juicy Crunch Mandarins
items.desc: noble juicy crunch mandarins are small to medium-sized, slightly flattened spheres. their rind is a vibrant, deep orange, smooth to slightly pebbled, and easily peelable. the fruit is firm yet yielding.

items.name: Oak Leaf Lettuce
items.desc: oak leaf lettuce has loose, deeply lobed leaves resembling oak tree leaves, typically a reddish-brown to green color. the leaves are tender and delicate, forming a loose, non-heading bunch with ruffled edges. it has a soft, buttery texture.

items.name: Okra - Chinese
items.desc: longer and often more slender than regular green okra, typically light green in color and can reach 6-10 inches in length. its skin may appear smoother or have less prominent ridges compared to other okra varieties. it shares the characteristic tapering shape.

items.name: Okra - Red
items.desc: distinctive deep red or burgundy-colored pods, slender and tapering to a point, similar in shape and length to regular green okra, averaging 3-6 inches. the vibrant red hue is noticeable, though it typically fades or disappears when cooked.

items.name: Okra - Regular (Green)
items.desc: slender, ridged, green pods tapering to a point at the end, typically 3-6 inches long. the exterior is covered in a fine, velvety fuzz. internally, it contains small, edible white seeds arranged in rows within a mucilaginous matrix.

items.name: Ong Choy (Water Spinach)
items.desc: long, hollow, light green stems with narrow, arrow-shaped dark green leaves. the stems are crunchy, and the leaves are tender, often having a slightly mucilaginous texture when cooked.

items.name: Onions - Pickling, White
items.desc: very small, spherical white onions, usually less than an inch in diameter. they have a thin, pearlescent white skin and crisp, mild-flavored white flesh. often sold in mesh bags rather than individually.

items.name: Onions, Bulb
items.desc: round or slightly oval, medium-sized onion typically covered with dry, papery brown or golden-yellow skin. when peeled, it reveals firm, pungent, concentric layers of whitish flesh. it fits comfortably in the palm of a hand.

items.name: Opal Apples
items.desc: showing bright golden yellow color, round shape, crisp appearance, no russeting

items.name: Opo Squash
items.desc: opo squash is a type of bottle gourd, typically 1 to 2 feet long, characterized by a smooth, light green skin, sometimes with subtle white speckles. its shape is often more rounded or bulbous at the bottom, gradually tapering into a narrower neck. it feels firm to the touch and has a relatively consistent girth throughout.

items.name: Orange Bell Pepper, Field Grown
items.desc: large blocky bell shape, bright orange, thick walls

items.name: Orange Bell Pepper, Greenhouse
items.desc: large blocky bell shape, bright orange, thick walls

items.name: Orange Cauliflower
items.desc: orange cauliflower forms a dense head (curd) composed of tightly packed florets, similar in structure to white cauliflower. its most prominent feature is its vibrant orange or cheddar-like color, which is naturally occurring due to high beta-carotene content. the leaves surrounding the head are typically green.

items.name: Orange Cherry Tomatoes
items.desc: small, perfectly round tomatoes, approximately 1 inch (2.5 cm) in diameter, characterized by their vibrant, glossy orange skin. they possess a thin skin and a juicy interior with a sweet, slightly tangy flavor.

items.name: Orange Flesh Cantaline Melon
items.desc: a round to slightly oval melon with a light tan, finely netted rind, similar in appearance to a cantaloupe. its distinguishing feature is its vibrant, deep orange flesh, which is usually richer in color than standard cantaloupes. it offers a very sweet, aromatic fragrance and a smooth, juicy texture.

items.name: Orange Seeded Watermelon
items.desc: showing whole watermelon with light green striped rind, with a cut wedge beside it revealing bright orange seedless flesh. the flesh is the color of a cantaloupe or mango — warm orange, not red, not pink.

items.name: Orange Seedless Watermelon
items.desc: showing whole oblong watermelon with dark green striped rind, with a cut wedge beside it revealing bright orange seedless flesh. the flesh is the color of a cantaloupe or mango — warm orange, not red, not pink.

items.name: Orange Tomatoes - On the Vine
items.desc: these are medium to large, round tomatoes, similar in size to standard slicing tomatoes, but with a vibrant, deep orange color. they are sold attached to a green vine in clusters. their skin is smooth and relatively firm, and they often offer a sweeter, less acidic flavor with fruity notes compared to red varieties.

items.name: Orange Tree Leaf
items.desc: orange tree leaves are glossy, dark green, oval-shaped, and slightly pointed at the tip, with smooth or very subtly toothed edges. they are firm and leathery to the touch, and when crushed, emit a distinct citrusy, aromatic fragrance. the leaf often has a prominent central vein and a small, winged petiole.

items.name: Oranges - Delta Seedless - Small
items.desc: a small, perfectly round, bright orange seedless orange with a smooth, thin rind. it strongly resembles a small valencia orange, making it ideal for juicing or easy eating. the small size makes it visually distinct from larger orange varieties.

items.name: Oranges - M4 (Dulce Navels ™)
items.desc: these are medium to large, round oranges with bright, vibrant orange peel that is relatively easy to peel. they feature a distinct 'navel' indentation at one end, which is actually a secondary rudimentary fruit. the flesh is seedless, juicy, and very sweet.

items.name: Oranges - Maltaise
items.desc: maltaise oranges are medium-sized, round to slightly oblate, with thin, smooth, and easily peelable skin that is a vibrant orange, sometimes with a faint red blush. the flesh is usually very juicy and sweet, often with a distinctive red or reddish-pink blush, especially in warmer climates. they have few seeds.

items.name: Oranges - Navel, Cara Cara
items.desc: a medium to large, seedless navel orange with a distinct internal 'navel' at one end. the exterior rind is bright orange, but the unique feature is its striking pinkish-red to ruby-red interior flesh, resembling a grapefruit. it offers a sweet, slightly tangy flavor with berry-like undertones and a low acid content.

items.name: Oranges - Navelate
items.desc: navelate oranges are a type of navel orange, typically medium to large, spherical with a characteristic 'navel' at the blossom end. they have bright orange, slightly textured, easily peelable skin and a sweet, juicy, seedless flesh that is deep orange in color. they are distinguished by their late harvest season.

items.name: Oranges - Navelina
items.desc: navelina oranges are a medium-sized, spherical variety of navel orange, known for their distinct navel formation on the blossom end. they possess a smooth, bright orange rind that is easy to peel, encasing a vibrant orange, seedless, and very juicy pulp with a balanced sweet-tart flavor. they are one of the earliest navel varieties to ripen.

items.name: Oranges - Pera
items.desc: pera oranges are typically medium-sized, round to slightly oval, with a thin, smooth, bright orange rind. they are known for their high juice content and minimal seeds. visually, they are indistinguishable from many other common sweet orange varieties, perhaps slightly elongated compared to a navel orange.

items.name: Oranges - Salustiana
items.desc: salustiana oranges are medium to large, round, with bright orange, smooth, and relatively thin skin that is easy to peel. their key characteristic is a very juicy, seedless, and sweet flesh, often paler orange in color than other varieties. the fruit has a slightly flattened base and a pleasant aroma.

items.name: Oranges - Seville
items.desc: a medium-sized, round orange with a thick, rough, dimpled rind that is typically a deep, vibrant orange color. it is highly aromatic but has very sour and bitter flesh, making it unsuitable for fresh eating. it is primarily used for its zest and juice in marmalades and culinary dishes.

items.name: Oranges - Shamouti
items.desc: this medium to large orange is distinctly oval-shaped with a thick, pebbled, and exceptionally easy-to-peel bright orange rind. it is typically seedless or contains very few seeds and often features a small, pronounced navel-like depression at one end. the flesh is juicy and sweet.

items.name: Oranges - Untreated
items.desc: these oranges vary in specific variety but typically appear similar to common eating oranges, round to slightly oblate, with an orange rind. the distinguishing feature is the lack of a shiny, waxy coating, giving the skin a duller, more natural, and sometimes slightly rougher texture compared to conventionally treated oranges. they may also show minor surface imperfections more readily.

items.name: Oranges - Valencia, Medium
items.desc: a medium-sized, round to slightly oval orange with a bright, often slightly pale, orange rind. it is known for its juicy, sweet-tart flesh, typically containing a few seeds, and is one of the primary varieties used for orange juice. the rind can sometimes have a greenish tinge even when ripe due to re-greening.

items.name: Oregano
items.desc: small, oval to slightly pointed, dark green leaves with a slightly rough texture, growing on woody stems. the leaves are typically firm and fragrant, and often have a more prominent vein pattern than marjoram. it has a stronger, more pungent aroma than marjoram and its leaves are generally firmer and more pointed.

items.name: Ornamental Gourd
items.desc: highly varied in shape, size, and color, often featuring irregular, bumpy, or warty textures. common shapes include bottle, pear, or speckled spheres, with colors ranging from green, yellow, orange, and white, sometimes striped or mottled. unlike pumpkins, they are typically not eaten and are purely decorative.

items.name: Oro Blanco/Sweetie Grapefruit
items.desc: showing pale green-yellow thick rind, round shape, very thick pith

items.name: Oyster Mushrooms
items.desc: showing pale white to gray fan shell-shaped cap, grows in overlapping clusters, very short stem

items.name: Oyster Plant/Salsify
items.desc: salsify typically presents as a long, slender, and cylindrical root vegetable, resembling a parsnip or a thin carrot. its skin is a dull, earthy brown or black, often with fine root hairs, and it can grow up to a foot in length. the inner flesh is white and firm, exuding a milky sap when cut.

items.name: Pacific Rose Apples
items.desc: showing distinctive rosy-pink blush, round shape, clean bright pink color

items.name: Pacific Rose Apples - Small
items.desc: small, round to slightly conical apples with a distinctive bright pink to rose-red skin, often with subtle cream undertones visible through the blush. the skin is smooth and slightly waxy. these are smaller than average, fitting easily into the palm of an adult's hand.

items.name: Packham Pears
items.desc: showing large pear, bumpy green skin, irregular shape

items.name: Papalo
items.desc: papalo leaves are distinctly large, flat, and somewhat wavy, much broader and more elongated than common cilantro. they exhibit a vibrant medium green color with a unique, somewhat irregular, almost spade or teardrop shape. the surface is smooth, and the herb carries a very strong, distinct aroma.

items.name: Papaya - Cooking/Mexican
items.desc: oval to pear-shaped fruit, often larger and firmer than regular papayas, typically sold unripe with a uniformly green, smooth skin. the flesh inside is pale white or very light green and firm, used more for savory dishes than sweet consumption. it has a less pronounced aroma than ripe papaya.

items.name: Papaya - Meridol
items.desc: a medium to large, elongated, pear-shaped papaya. the smooth skin ripens from green to a vibrant yellow-orange color when mature. inside, the flesh is firm, bright orange, and very sweet with a musky aroma. it contains numerous small, round, black, edible seeds in its central cavity.

items.name: Papaya - Regular - Small
items.desc: small, elongated, pear-shaped or cylindrical fruit with smooth, thin skin that ripens from green to yellow-orange. the skin can show slight blemishes or streaks. it is notably smaller than common large papayas.

items.name: Papaya - Regular Large
items.desc: large, elongated oval fruit with smooth, thin skin that ripens from green to yellow-orange. the flesh inside is vibrant orange-red with a central cavity filled with small, round, black seeds. this is a larger variety compared to others.

items.name: Papaya, Solo Sunrise
items.desc: showing pear-shaped fruit, green turning yellow-orange when ripe

items.name: Parsley Root
items.desc: a taproot vegetable resembling a white carrot or parsnip, with a creamy white to pale yellow skin. it has a conical shape, often with fine root hairs and a slightly rough texture. it typically comes with a small crown of green parsley-like leaves attached.

items.name: Parsley, Curly
items.desc: showing bright green tightly curled ruffled leaves, dense feathery bunches

items.name: Parsley, Italian Flat Leaf
items.desc: showing bright green flat pointed serrated leaves, resembles cilantro but darker

items.name: Parsnips
items.desc: showing long tapered cream-white root, like a white carrot

items.name: Pasilla Pepper, Green
items.desc: long 6-9 inch pepper, dark green to brown, narrow wrinkled skin

items.name: Pasilla Pod Peppers
items.desc: mature, very elongated peppers, often 8-12 inches long, with a deep, dark brown-black or very dark reddish-brown hue. their skin is typically quite wrinkled and somewhat leathery to the touch, and they maintain a slender, slightly tapered form. these are larger and more intensely colored than standard pasillas.

items.name: Pasilla Red Peppers
items.desc: long, thin, and often slightly twisted peppers, typically 6-10 inches in length. they display a rich, dark red to reddish-brown color, with a somewhat wrinkled, glossy skin. the shape is usually elongated and tapered, resembling a narrow, mature poblano.

items.name: Passion Fire™ Grapes
items.desc: passion fire grapes display a deep, uniform reddish-purple color across their skin. they are medium-sized and oval to slightly elongated, forming compact clusters and possessing a firm, juicy flesh.

items.name: Passion Fruit (Granadilla)
items.desc: showing small round purple-brown wrinkled skin, hard shell

items.name: Passion Fruit - Curuba/Banana
items.desc: this passion fruit variety is distinctively elongated and oval, resembling a small banana, hence its name. its skin is a vibrant yellow to orange when ripe, smooth and leathery. it's typically smaller and thinner than a regular banana, with a subtle point at the stem end.

items.name: Passion Fruit - Granadilla - Yellow/Maracuja
items.desc: this is a larger, round to oval passion fruit with a glossy, smooth, bright yellow to orange rind. unlike the purple passion fruit, its skin doesn't typically wrinkle much when ripe, remaining taut and firm. it's notably larger than common purple varieties, often the size of a tennis ball.

items.name: Passion Fruit - Purple
items.desc: small, round to oval fruit, typically 2-3 inches in diameter, with a thick, wrinkled, dark purple skin when ripe. the interior contains fragrant, juicy yellow-orange pulp and numerous small, edible black seeds. its skin becomes more wrinkled as it ripens, indicating optimal sweetness.

items.name: Paulared Apples - Large
items.desc: large-sized, early-season apple with a striking, uniform bright red color that covers most of its surface, sometimes with faint white lenticels. it has a classic round to slightly conical apple shape and a smooth, waxy skin.

items.name: Paulared Apples - Small
items.desc: small-sized, early-season apple with a striking, uniform bright red color that covers most of its surface, sometimes with faint white lenticels. it has a classic round to slightly conical apple shape and a smooth, waxy skin.

items.name: Pazazz Apples
items.desc: pazazz apples are medium to large, roundish with a slightly conical shape. they have a vibrant, mottled skin, primarily bright red over a yellow-green base, often with prominent lenticels. the texture is firm and crunchy, and they hold their shape well.

items.name: Peaches - Flat Yellow Flesh
items.desc: this peach variety is distinctly flattened, resembling a donut, with a depressed center on both ends. its skin is a fuzzy mix of red blush over a yellow-orange base, and the flesh inside is bright yellow. this item comes in various sizes, all sharing the characteristic flattened shape.

items.name: Peaches - Indian
items.desc: a unique peach variety, typically medium-sized and round, with a fuzzy skin that can range from mottled green to yellow, often with distinct red streaks or blush. its defining feature is the striking deep red or purple-veined flesh that bleeds into the pit, offering a sweet yet slightly tart flavor.

items.name: Peaches - Red Flesh
items.desc: these peaches are medium-sized, round to slightly heart-shaped, with skin that can range from fuzzy yellow-orange with a red blush to almost entirely deep red. the defining characteristic is their intensely dark red, almost burgundy, flesh that is juicy, highly aromatic, and has a strong, unique sweet-tart flavor, often with raspberry or cherry notes. the pit is typically free or semi-free.

items.name: Peaches - White Flesh - Large
items.desc: large, robustly round to slightly ovate peaches, with a soft, fuzzy skin displaying creamy yellow undertones often heavily blushed with pink and red. this size is significantly larger than a standard peach, often requiring two hands or a wide grip to hold, and has a prominent furrow.

items.name: Peaches - White Flesh - Small
items.desc: small, round to slightly ovate peaches with a velvety, fuzzy skin that transitions from a pale creamy yellow to a blush of pink or red. this specific size is noticeably smaller than standard peaches, fitting easily in the palm of a hand. the skin is delicate and easily bruised.

items.name: Peaches - Yellow Flesh (Tree Ripened) - Large
items.desc: a large, round to slightly ovate peach with fuzzy skin, displaying a vivid mix of red and orange blush over a sunny yellow base. it feels soft to the touch, indicating ripeness. this is the larger version compared to its small counterpart.

items.name: Peaches - Yellow Flesh (Tree Ripened) - Small
items.desc: a small, round to slightly ovate peach with fuzzy skin, showcasing a blend of red and orange blush over a sunny yellow background. it feels soft to the touch, indicating ripeness. this is the smaller version compared to its large counterpart.

items.name: Peaches - Yellow Flesh Large
items.desc: large, round to slightly oblong fruit with a velvety, fuzzy skin that transitions from a golden yellow base to a vibrant red blush where exposed to sun. the succulent, aromatic flesh is a rich yellow, typically freestone, surrounding a central pit. this is a noticeably larger peach, often requiring two hands to hold comfortably.

items.name: Peaches - Yellow Flesh Small
items.desc: small, round to slightly heart-shaped fruit with a soft, fuzzy skin that blushes from yellow to red. the interior reveals fragrant, juicy, bright yellow flesh that is typically freestone or semi-freestone. this is a smaller variant, fitting easily into the palm of a hand.

items.name: Peaches, White, Large
items.desc: showing pale cream-white skin with slight pink blush, round with crease, fuzzy skin

items.name: Peaches, White, Small
items.desc: showing pale cream-white skin with slight pink blush, round with crease, fuzzy skin

items.name: Peaches, Yellow Flesh, Large
items.desc: large, round to slightly oval fruit with soft, fuzzy skin, typically displaying a gradient of yellow-orange with blushes of red. features a prominent seam running down one side. its significantly larger size differentiates it from smaller peach varieties.

items.name: Peaches, Yellow Flesh, Small
items.desc: small, round to slightly oval fruit with soft, fuzzy skin, typically displaying a gradient of yellow-orange with blushes of red. features a prominent seam running down one side. the small size helps distinguish it from larger peaches.

items.name: Peaches, Yellow, Large
items.desc: showing golden-yellow skin with red blush, round with crease, characteristic fuzzy velvety skin

items.name: Peaches, Yellow, Small
items.desc: showing golden-yellow skin with red blush, round with crease, characteristic fuzzy velvety skin

items.name: Pearl Onions
items.desc: showing very small marble-sized, white, round, sold in bags

items.name: Pears - Alexander Lucas
items.desc: alexander lucas pears are large, broad, and somewhat irregular in shape, typically with a short neck and a wider base. their skin is smooth, usually light green, ripening to a pale yellow, often with patches of russeting or a slight red blush. the flesh is white, fine-grained, very juicy, and sweet, known for a buttery texture when ripe.

items.name: Pears - Angelys
items.desc: medium to large, roundish-conical pears, often broader at the base than other varieties, with a shorter neck. the skin is typically a golden-green, developing a distinct russeted texture, especially around the stem and blossom end, giving it an antique, rustic appearance.

items.name: Pears - Carmen
items.desc: medium-sized, classic pear-shaped fruit with a bright green base color that develops a significant red blush across much of its surface when ripe. the skin is smooth and thin, often appearing slightly waxy, and tapers gracefully from a broad base to a slender neck.

items.name: Pears - Fragrant
items.desc: fragrant pears, often referring to varieties like asian pears, are typically round to slightly oblate in shape, distinct from the traditional bell-shape of european pears. their skin color varies from a golden-yellow to a light greenish-brown, often with a slightly rough or russeted texture and visible lenticels (small dots). they have a firm, crisp flesh and a distinctive, sweet aroma.

items.name: Pears - General Leclerc
items.desc: this pear is often rounder and wider at the base than typical pears, sometimes appearing almost squat. it features a russeted, golden-brown skin that can develop an attractive red blush, with a slightly textured surface. its flesh is fine-grained and very juicy.

items.name: Pears - Guyot
items.desc: a medium-sized pear with a classic, elegant bell shape, tapering gracefully towards the stem. it has a smooth, bright yellow-green skin, which may develop a subtle pink blush when fully ripe. the flesh is white, tender, and distinctly aromatic.

items.name: Pears - Harovin Sundown
items.desc: harovin sundown pears are medium to large in size, exhibiting a classic bell shape with a smooth, bright yellow-green skin. they often develop a subtle reddish blush on the side exposed to the sun. the skin is thin, and the flesh is firm and juicy, tapering distinctly towards the stem.

items.name: Pears - Josephine
