items.desc: this medium-sized pear presents a classic, plump pear shape with a broad base and a distinct neck. its thin, delicate skin starts pale green and ripens to a soft yellow, often with a hint of red blush, and may show small russet dots. the flesh is exceptionally melting and fragrant.

items.name: Pears - Louise Bonne
items.desc: louise bonne pears are medium-sized, distinctly pyriform (classic pear shape) with a moderately long neck tapering to a rounded base. the skin is thin, smooth, bright green, developing a yellowish tint when ripe, and often adorned with an attractive red flush on the sunny side and small russet dots. the flesh is white, juicy, melting, and very sweet with a delicate aroma.

items.name: Pears - Passe Crassane - Large
items.desc: large, round to slightly squat pears, resembling an apple in shape more than a typical pear, with a broad base and a short neck. the skin is often thick and green-yellow, heavily covered with fine russeting, giving it a rough, earthy texture. this specific size is notably bigger than most common pears, often wider than a clenched fist.

items.name: Pears - Passe Crassane - Small
items.desc: this small pear has an unusual, almost round or oblate shape, resembling an apple more than a typical pear. it features a thick, rough, russeted green skin that turns golden-yellow when ripe, often with a distinctive cork-like 'cap' at the stem end. its texture is firm and gritty.

items.name: Pears - Rocha
items.desc: a small to medium-sized pear characterized by its squat, roundish shape, often with a distinct cinnamon-colored russet patch around the stem. the smooth, yellow-green skin ripens to a full golden color. its flesh is crisp and sweet.

items.name: Pears - Rosemarie
items.desc: this medium-sized pear boasts a beautiful, classic bell shape with strikingly smooth skin. the skin transitions from a light green base to a vibrant, often extensive, red blush, making it very visually appealing. small, light lenticels are often visible on its surface.

items.name: Pears - Santa Maria
items.desc: santa maria pears are medium to large, conical with a broad base and a distinct neck, resembling a bartlett pear. their skin is smooth, thin, and bright green, turning to a golden yellow when ripe, often exhibiting a beautiful red blush over one side. the flesh is white, crisp, very juicy, and sweet with a fine texture and mild aroma.

items.name: Pears - Starkrimson
items.desc: this pear has a distinctive bright crimson to deep red skin that completely covers the fruit, setting it apart from other pears. its classic bell shape tapers from a wide, rounded base to a narrower neck. the skin is smooth and thin.

items.name: Pears - Triumph de Vienne
items.desc: a large, elongated pear with a distinctive classic necked shape and a broad base. its smooth skin is a vibrant greenish-yellow, sometimes with a faint reddish flush, and can have a slightly waxy or oily feel. the flesh is known for being exceptionally tender and juicy.

items.name: Pepino Melon
items.desc: the pepino melon is oval to tear-drop shaped with a thin, smooth skin that is bright yellow to golden-orange, often adorned with distinctive purple or maroon stripes. its flesh is pale yellow-orange, juicy, and has a mild, sweet flavor, sometimes likened to a blend of cantaloupe and pear.

items.name: Peppermint Mint
items.desc: peppermint mint is identified by its dark green, oval to lance-shaped leaves with serrated edges, growing opposite each other on square stems. the leaves often have a slight reddish or purplish tint, especially near the veins or stem, and possess a distinctively strong, cool menthol aroma when bruised.

items.name: Persian Melon
items.desc: showing dark green rind with fine netting, larger than cantaloupe, round

items.name: Persimmon
items.desc: showing bright orange smooth glossy skin, flat green calyx, tomato-like shape

items.name: Pickling Cucumbers
items.desc: showing small 3-4 inch bumpy dark green cucumber, blocky stubby kirby variety

items.name: Pie Pumpkin
items.desc: smaller than carving pumpkins, typically weighing 2-8 pounds, with a round to slightly oblong shape. the skin is a dark, dull orange and usually has fewer, less pronounced ribs than larger decorative pumpkins. it has a firm, dense flesh ideal for cooking, and a short, sturdy green or brown stem.

items.name: Pimiento Pepper
items.desc: small 3-4 inch pepper, bright red, heart-shaped, thick flesh, very sweet

items.name: Pineapple - Dried
items.desc: pale to golden yellow, translucent, irregularly shaped pieces or rings, often slightly sticky or chewy in texture. they are typically flat or slightly curled, with a concentrically patterned surface from the original pineapple flesh. much smaller and firmer than fresh pineapple.

items.name: Pineapple - Jet Fresh - Large
items.desc: large pineapples are oval, spiky tropical fruits, typically weighing 4-6 pounds, with a tough, segmented brownish-green skin. a vibrant green leafy crown emerges from the top. the interior consists of juicy, fibrous, bright yellow flesh with a distinct sweet-tart tropical aroma and flavor.

items.name: Pineapple - Mini
items.desc: mini pineapples are significantly smaller than standard pineapples, typically cylindrical to oval with a spiky, crown of green leaves. their rough, scaly rind is orange-brown when ripe, and the fruit usually measures about 4-6 inches tall. the golden-yellow flesh is very sweet, less fibrous, and more aromatic than larger varieties, often with an edible core.

items.name: Pineapple - Perola
items.desc: the perola pineapple is typically medium to large, with a somewhat conical to cylindrical shape. its skin is a greenish-yellow when ripe, developing a golden hue, and features prominent, spiky dark green crowns. the flesh is pale yellow to almost white, known for being very sweet and less acidic than other varieties.

items.name: Pineapple, Large
items.desc: showing golden-brown diamond-patterned rind with spiky green crown of leaves on top, cylindrical

items.name: Pineapple, Small
items.desc: a miniature version of the classic pineapple, about half the size of a standard pineapple. it retains the same tough, spiky, segmented brown-gold rind and a prominent crown of stiff, green leaves. its compact, often more squat size is its primary distinguishing feature, but it has the same aroma and visual texture as larger pineapples.

items.name: Pineapple, Small
items.desc: showing golden-brown diamond-patterned rind with spiky green crown of leaves on top, cylindrical

items.name: Pink (Porcelain Doll) Pumpkin
items.desc: a medium to large pumpkin, distinctly flattened and deeply ribbed, with a unique pale pink to almost peach-colored skin. its surface is smooth and slightly powdery in appearance, differing from the rougher texture of other pumpkins. it has a robust woody stem and a very symmetrical, decorative form.

items.name: Pink Lady Apples, Large
items.desc: showing distinctive pink-rose blush over bright green background, firm smooth skin, vivid two-tone pink and green

items.name: Pink Lady Apples, Small
items.desc: showing distinctive pink-rose blush over bright green background, firm smooth skin, vivid two-tone pink and green

items.name: Pinole Peppers
items.desc: small to medium-sized, somewhat conical peppers, 2-4 inches long, with a smooth, glossy skin. they are typically a bright red or vibrant orange color, tapering to a distinct pointed tip. the walls are usually moderately thick and firm.

items.name: Pinova Apple
items.desc: pinova apples are medium-sized and round-conical in shape. their skin is primarily a bright yellow, often covered with a striking orange-red blush or stripes. the skin is smooth and relatively thin, revealing crisp, firm, and juicy pale yellow flesh.

items.name: Pippin Apples, Large
items.desc: showing green-yellow color, round-flat shape, dull matte skin, may have russeting

items.name: Pippin Apples, Small
items.desc: showing green-yellow color, round-flat shape, dull matte skin, may have russeting

items.name: Pitahaya - Red flesh (Fire Dragons)
items.desc: showing whole oval dragon fruit with bright pink-magenta skin and green-tipped scale-like leafy growths, with a cut half laid beside it perpendicular revealing vibrant magenta-red flesh speckled with tiny black seeds.

items.name: Pitahaya - Yellow
items.desc: this fruit is oval to oblong and bright canary yellow, covered with small, soft, thorn-like protrusions that are characteristic but not sharp. it's generally smaller and more elongated than the red-skinned pitahaya, with a smoother, slightly translucent skin that often hides small black seeds visible through the surface.

items.name: Plantains
items.desc: showing large green to yellow banana, larger firmer and more angular than regular banana

items.name: Plumac Apples
items.desc: plumac apples are medium to large, often conical in shape, featuring a bright red blush that covers most of the fruit, sometimes over a greenish-yellow base. the skin is smooth and somewhat glossy. they present a classic apple silhouette.

items.name: Plumcot (Pluot®)
items.desc: plumcots are smooth-skinned hybrid fruits, often round or slightly oval, ranging in color from deep red to mottled green-red, sometimes with specks. their skin is typically thin, and the firm, juicy flesh can be amber, pink, or crimson, surrounding a single small pit.

items.name: Plums - Tree Ripened - Large
items.desc: large tree-ripened plums are substantial, round to slightly oblong fruits, typically 2.5-3 inches in diameter, with smooth, sometimes slightly dusty skin. colors vary from deep purple to ruby red or greenish-yellow, often with a visible seam. the flesh is very succulent and sweet, with a firm yet yielding texture around a single central pit, significantly larger than small plums.

items.name: Plums - Tree Ripened - Small
items.desc: small tree-ripened plums are petite, round to oval fruits, typically 1.5-2 inches in diameter, with a smooth, taut skin that can be dark purple, red, or greenish-yellow. they often have a whitish bloom on the surface and a distinct furrow running down one side. the flesh is juicy, sweet, and tender, clinging to a single central pit. these are noticeably smaller than their large counterparts.

items.name: Plums - Yellow - Large
items.desc: large yellow plums, such as golden globe, are substantial, round to slightly oval fruits, measuring 2.5-3 inches in diameter, distinguished by their bright, unblemished yellow skin. the skin is smooth and thin, sometimes with a faint blush. inside, the golden flesh is very sweet, tart, and exceptionally juicy, surrounding a central freestone pit, making them significantly larger than small yellow plums.

items.name: Plums - Yellow - Small
items.desc: small yellow plums, including golden globe, are petite, round fruits, generally 1.5-2 inches across, with a vibrant, uniformly sunny yellow skin. their surface is smooth and often covered in a fine, powdery bloom. the interior flesh is typically golden, juicy, and very sweet, encasing a small, oval pit, and are noticeably smaller than large yellow plums.

items.name: Plums, Black, Large
items.desc: showing dark purple-black skin, round, dusty bloom

items.name: Plums, Black, Small
items.desc: showing dark purple-black skin, round, dusty bloom

items.name: Plums, Green, Large
items.desc: showing green to yellow-green skin, round, firm, tart kelsey or greengage variety

items.name: Plums, Green, Small
items.desc: showing green to yellow-green skin, round, firm, tart kelsey or greengage variety

items.name: Plums, Purple, Large
items.desc: a single large oval dark purple plum, larger than a golf ball, deep purple to near-black smooth skin with subtle dusty bloom, a distinct crease line running from stem to tip, small brown dried stem at the top. noticeably larger than a small purple plum.

items.name: Plums, Purple, Small
items.desc: a single small round dark purple plum, smaller than a golf ball, deep purple smooth skin with dusty bloom, small brown stem at top. distinctly smaller and rounder than a large plum.

items.name: Plums, Red, Large
items.desc: showing bright red skin, round, slightly larger than black plum, red flesh

items.name: Plums, Red, Small
items.desc: showing bright red skin, round, slightly larger than black plum, red flesh

items.name: Poblano Pepper
items.desc: large 4-6 inch pepper, wide and flat, dark green almost black-green, heart-shaped

items.name: Pole Beans
items.desc: these beans are characterized by their long, straight, and slightly rounded pods, typically 6-10 inches in length. they come in various shades of green, sometimes with purple streaks or mottling. the texture is firm and crisp, with a smooth to slightly bumpy surface, and they are usually harvested when tender, before the seeds fully develop.

items.name: Polk Greens
items.desc: large, ovate to lance-shaped leaves with smooth margins and prominent veins, typically dark green. they are often sold as loose leaves or in bunches, sometimes with tender young stems, and require cooking before consumption.

items.name: Pomegranate - Large
items.desc: large pomegranates are round, roughly apple-sized or larger, with a tough, leathery skin that ranges in color from deep red to reddish-brown. they typically have a prominent crown-like calyx at one end. the interior is filled with numerous edible arils (seeds surrounded by juicy pulp) separated by bitter white membranes. this is a large variant of the fruit.

items.name: Pomegranate, Medium
items.desc: showing red-brown leathery skin, round with prominent crown calyx

items.name: Pomegranate, Small
items.desc: showing red-brown leathery skin, round with prominent crown calyx

items.name: Portabella Mushrooms
items.desc: showing very large 4-6 inch dark brown cap, wide open with exposed dark gills, thick stem

items.name: Potato - Creamer - Red
items.desc: these are small, round to slightly oblong potatoes with smooth, thin, vibrant red skin. the flesh inside is typically white or pale yellow and waxy, holding its shape well when cooked. they are smaller than standard red potatoes, usually 1 to 2 inches in diameter, and have a firm texture.

items.name: Potato - Creamer - White
items.desc: small, oval to round potatoes characterized by their smooth, thin, off-white or light tan skin. the interior flesh is white and waxy, firming up nicely when cooked. they are typically 1 to 2 inches in size, smaller than most common potatoes, and maintain a firm shape.

items.name: Potato - Long - White
items.desc: these potatoes are elongated and oval, with smooth, thin, white to light tan skin. their flesh is typically white and medium-starchy, making them versatile for various cooking methods. they are larger than creamer potatoes but generally smoother and less irregular than russets, measuring about 3 to 6 inches long.

items.name: Potato - Russet
items.desc: large, oblong potatoes with thick, rough, brown skin, often covered in small imperfections or "eyes". the flesh is white and floury, ideal for baking or mashing due to its high starch content. they typically have an elongated, somewhat irregular shape and can range from 4 to 8 inches in length.

items.name: PremA17 Apples - Large
items.desc: a large, firm apple with a classic round to conical shape, displaying a vibrant red blush over a yellow-green base. its smooth, slightly waxy skin often has subtle visible lenticels. its substantial size clearly differentiates it from smaller apple varieties.

items.name: PremA280 Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, generally round apple characterized by a glossy, deep red skin that typically covers most of its surface, sometimes with subtle green undertones near the stem. the skin is smooth and firm, presenting a very uniform appearance.

items.name: President Plums
items.desc: large, oval-shaped plums with a deep purplish-blue skin, often covered in a fine, powdery, natural waxy bloom. the fruit has firm, juicy, golden-yellow flesh that is sweet and clings to a single large pit.

items.name: Prince Melon
items.desc: a small, round melon with a delicately netted, light green to yellow rind. its defining characteristic is its vibrant, intense orange flesh, which is highly aromatic and generally sweeter than a traditional cantaloupe. these melons typically weigh between 1-2 pounds.

items.name: Pummelo, Red
items.desc: very large, larger than grapefruit, thick spongy rind, pale green-yellow skin, teardrop shape

items.name: Pummelo, White
items.desc: very large, thick rind, pale green-yellow skin, teardrop pear shape

items.name: Pumpkin
items.desc: showing classic round orange pumpkin shape, ribbed, with green stem

items.name: Pumpkin - Mini
items.desc: these pumpkins are distinctively small, typically 3-5 inches in diameter, with a bright orange, smooth, and slightly ribbed skin. they have a classic pumpkin shape, but miniaturized, often featuring a short, sturdy green stem. their flesh is edible but they are often used for decoration.

items.name: Pumpkin Vine
items.desc: pumpkin vine consists of tender, flexible green stems with attached large, broad, lobed leaves and sometimes delicate, coiling tendrils. the stems can have a slightly fuzzy texture, and the leaves are a vibrant medium to dark green. it is typically sold coiled or bundled, showcasing its sprawling nature.

items.name: Purple Bell Pepper
items.desc: large blocky bell shape, dark purple eggplant color

items.name: Purple Herb
items.desc: this herb is visually striking with its deep purple to burgundy coloration across its slender, grass-like leaves and stems. the leaves are long, narrow, and taper to a point, growing upright in dense clumps. it offers a firm texture and a vibrant visual contrast to other green herbs.

items.name: Purple Hull Beans
items.desc: these distinctive beans are encased in vibrant, deep purple pods, typically 4-6 inches long and slender. the pods are smooth and glossy, with a slight curve, and house small, light-colored beans, often cream or green, sometimes with a 'black eye' spot. the intense purple color of the pod is a key visual identifier.

items.name: Purple Potato
items.desc: oval to oblong shape, typically medium in size. the skin is a deep, vibrant purple, sometimes almost blue-black, with a slightly rough or netted texture. the flesh inside is also purple, maintaining its color when cooked, and it has a firm, earthy appearance.

items.name: QTee® Pears
items.desc: qtee pears are distinct with their vibrant red blush covering a significant portion of their bright yellow-green skin. they are small to medium, have a classic pyriform shape, and possess a smooth, delicate surface.

items.name: Queen Pineapple
items.desc: this pineapple variety is smaller and more compact than common types, typically oval or conical in shape with a spiky, deep green crown. the eyes on its rind are prominent and relatively deep, and the flesh is a pale yellow to white, very sweet, juicy, and less acidic with a strong aroma. the skin is a dull orange-yellow when ripe.

items.name: Quelites
items.desc: quelites refers to various edible wild greens, typically appearing as small, tender leaves attached to thin, often delicate stems. the colors range from light to dark green, and leaf shapes can vary widely, but are generally small and soft. they are often sold bunched together, showcasing a rustic, foraged appearance.

items.name: Quince
items.desc: a large, firm fruit with an irregular, often bumpy pear-like shape and a fuzzy, bright yellow skin when ripe. it has a strong, perfumed aroma. the flesh is hard and gritty, typically requiring cooking before consumption, unlike softer pears.

items.name: Rabbit Herb
items.desc: rabbit herb is characterized by its small, delicate, light green leaves which possess a subtly fuzzy texture. the leaves are often oval or elongated and grow along thin, tender stems, giving it a soft, wispy appearance. it has a fresh, mild aroma and is typically sold in small, unassuming bunches.

items.name: Radicchio
items.desc: radicchio is easily identified by its striking deep reddish-purple leaves with prominent white veins, forming a compact, round, or slightly elongated head. the leaves are firm and slightly bitter, resembling a small cabbage or a very colorful head of lettuce. it typically measures 4-6 inches in diameter and has a firm, dense feel.

items.name: Radicchio - Castelfranco
items.desc: resembles a loose, open rose with creamy white or pale green leaves splashed with vibrant crimson or purple flecks. the leaves are tender and have a milder, sweeter, and less bitter flavor compared to other radicchio varieties.

items.name: Radicchio - Treviso
items.desc: elongated, torpedo-shaped head with striking deep burgundy-red leaves and prominent white veins running through them. the texture is crisp, and the flavor is distinctly bitter and peppery.

items.name: Radish - Black
items.desc: a single whole black radish — large round root about 3-4 inches diameter with rough, matte, very dark brown-black skin, a small taproot at the bottom, and short green leafy stalks growing from the top. no cross-section. much larger and darker than a common red radish.

items.name: Radish - Bunched White
items.desc: a bunch of 5-6 elongated cylindrical white radishes bundled together, each 3-5 inches long with smooth pure white skin tapering to a thin root tip, vibrant green leafy tops still attached and tied in a bundle. white color throughout, no red.

items.name: Radish - Italian Red
items.desc: italian red radishes are small, round to slightly oval-shaped, about 1 inch in diameter, with a bright, uniform red skin and crisp. they often have a small, delicate taproot and are sold with or without their vibrant green tops. their flavor is mildly peppery and refreshing.

items.name: Radish - Red
items.desc: small, round to slightly oval root vegetable, typically with a small white taproot at the bottom. the skin is a vibrant, glossy red, smooth, and contrasts with the crisp, white, peppery flesh inside. often sold with small green stems attached.

items.name: Radish - White/Icicle
items.desc: a single white icicle radish — long slender cylindrical root 4-6 inches long, tapering to a fine point like an icicle, uniformly smooth pure white skin, small green stem at the top. resembles a thin white carrot. no red coloring.

items.name: Radishes, Red, Bunch
items.desc: a bunch of 6-8 small round red radishes bundled together with their green leafy tops still attached and tied together. multiple red radishes visible, each with vibrant red skin and a small white taproot tip.

items.name: Rainier Cherries
items.desc: showing distinctive creamy golden-yellow skin with red-pink blush on one side, not dark red, bi-colored rainier cherry, heart shape, with stem

items.name: Rambutan
items.desc: showing red fruit with soft hairy spiny protrusions covering exterior, round

items.name: Rave™/First Kiss™ Apples
items.desc: these apples have a vibrant reddish-pink skin, often with subtle yellow undertones and prominent lenticels. they are medium-sized and have a somewhat conical to round shape, with a smooth, firm surface.

items.name: Red Apricots
items.desc: these small, round to slightly oval stone fruits have a smooth, velvety skin that is predominantly red, sometimes with a blush of orange or yellow underneath. they feature a single, large pit inside and a soft, juicy flesh. the skin may show a faint fuzzy texture.

items.name: Red Baking Potato
items.desc: this potato is characterized by its smooth, vibrant red skin, often with shallow eyes that may appear slightly redder or deeper in color. it has a rounded to oval shape and a firm, creamy white flesh. while traditionally known for boiling or roasting, specific red varieties like 'red eye' are suited for baking, offering a slightly denser texture than white baking potatoes.

items.name: Red Bananas
items.desc: showing distinctive dark reddish-purple skin, shorter and plumper than yellow banana

items.name: Red Bell Pepper (Field Grown)
items.desc: large blocky bell shape, bright red, thick walls

items.name: Red Bell Pepper, Greenhouse
items.desc: large blocky bell shape, bright red, thick walls

items.name: Red Cabbage
items.desc: showing dense round head, deep purple-red leaves

items.name: Red Cheese Peppers
items.desc: small, round or slightly flattened peppers, 1-2 inches in diameter, resembling a small tomato or cherry. they possess a vibrant, glossy, deep red skin and a thick, sweet flesh, often with visible ribs or slight indentations. their shape is distinctly squat and plump.

items.name: Red Cherry Tomatoes - On the Vine
items.desc: these are small, perfectly round tomatoes, approximately 1 inch in diameter, displaying a bright, vivid red color. they are sold attached to a short, green vine segment, typically in clusters of several tomatoes. their smooth, thin skin is prone to bursting when ripe.

items.name: Red Cocktail Tomatoes
items.desc: these are round, bright red tomatoes, intermediate in size between cherry and full-sized slicing tomatoes, typically 1.5-2 inches in diameter. they have smooth skin and are commonly sold loose or in small clamshells. their balanced sweet and acidic flavor makes them versatile for culinary use.

items.name: Red Currants
items.desc: red currants are small, translucent, ruby-red berries clustered on slender stems. each berry is approximately the size of a small pea, with a glossy, thin skin and tiny seeds inside. they have a tart flavor and are often used in desserts or jellies.

items.name: Red Delicious Apples - Extra Large
items.desc: extra large red delicious apples are distinctly conical or heart-shaped, with five prominent lobes at the base. their skin is a deep, uniform glossy red, often with very subtle stripes or flecks, and they are notably larger than standard red delicious apples. the flesh is crisp, white, and juicy.

items.name: Red Delicious Apples, Large
items.desc: showing characteristic deep uniform dark red color, tall elongated shape with five pronounced bumps at bottom, thick skin with waxy sheen

items.name: Red Delicious Apples, Large (Alt)
items.desc: showing characteristic deep uniform dark red color, tall elongated shape with five pronounced bumps at bottom, thick skin with waxy sheen

items.name: Red Delicious Apples, Small
items.desc: showing characteristic deep uniform dark red color, tall elongated shape with five pronounced bumps at bottom, thick skin with waxy sheen

items.name: Red Delicious Apples, Small (Alt)
items.desc: showing characteristic deep uniform dark red color, tall elongated shape with five pronounced bumps at bottom, thick skin with waxy sheen

items.name: Red Finger Peppers
items.desc: slender, elongated peppers, typically 3-5 inches long, with a slightly curved, elegant shape resembling a finger. they have a bright, glossy red skin that is smooth and firm, and a relatively thin to medium-thick flesh. they taper gently to a blunt or slightly pointed end.

items.name: Red Globe Grapes
items.desc: showing large individual bright red seeded grapes, much larger than standard

items.name: Red Grapes, Seedless
items.desc: showing small round deep red-purple seedless grapes in bunch

items.name: Red Jonaprince Apples
items.desc: medium to large, round-conical apples with a bright, glossy, deep red skin that often displays subtle stripes over a yellow-green background. the flesh is notably crisp, juicy, and offers a balanced sweet-tart flavor.

items.name: Red Kuri Squash
items.desc: showing bright red-orange teardrop shape, smooth skin, onion-shaped

items.name: Red Leaf Lettuce
items.desc: showing loose ruffled leaves with deep red-burgundy tips fading to green base

items.name: Red Onion
items.desc: showing deep purple-red papery skin, round globe shape

items.name: Red Onions - Bunch
items.desc: these are immature red onions sold with their green tops still attached, forming a bunch. the small bulbs are white at the base, transitioning to a vibrant reddish-purple skin as they mature slightly, with long, upright green stalks. they have a crisp texture and milder flavor than mature bulbs.

items.name: Red Pears
items.desc: showing red-skinned pear, classic pear shape with red coloring

items.name: Red Plumcot
items.desc: small to medium-sized fruit, round to slightly oval in shape. the skin is smooth and thin, a vibrant red or reddish-purple color, often with a subtle dusty bloom. it has a firm texture, similar to a plum, and a single central pit.

items.name: Red Potatoes
items.desc: showing smooth thin red skin, round shape, waxy appearance

items.name: Red Raspberries
items.desc: showing bright red aggregate drupelets, cone-shaped, hollow center when picked

items.name: Red/Black Cherries - Large
items.desc: these large, round cherries have a glossy skin that ranges from deep red to nearly black, often with a slender green stem attached. the color is uniform and rich, indicating ripeness. they are noticeably larger in diameter compared to the small variety.

items.name: Red/Black Cherries - Small
items.desc: these small, round cherries have a glossy skin that ranges from deep red to nearly black, often with a slender green stem attached. the color is uniform and rich, indicating ripeness. they are noticeably smaller in diameter compared to the large variety.

items.name: RedPop® Apples
items.desc: redpop® apples are characterized by their striking, intense cherry-red skin, which often covers nearly the entire fruit with a high sheen. they have a medium, somewhat conical shape and a very firm appearance. the skin is notably smooth and thin.

items.name: Redfield (Mahana Red) Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, round apples covered almost entirely in a rich, uniform dark red skin, occasionally with very subtle darker streaks or a slightly matte finish. they possess firm, juicy, and somewhat tart flesh, making them suitable for both eating and cooking. their deep, consistent red hue is a defining characteristic.

items.name: Regent Apples - Large
items.desc: regent apples are large, round to slightly conical, featuring a thick, deep red skin that often covers a yellow-green background. the skin can be somewhat rough. the flesh is firm and crunchy. this is the larger size variant for regent apples.

items.name: Regent Apples - Small
items.desc: regent apples are medium-sized, round to slightly conical, featuring a thick, deep red skin that often covers a yellow-green background. the skin can be somewhat rough. the flesh is firm and crunchy. this is the smaller size variant for regent apples.

items.name: Reine des Reinettes Apples - Large
items.desc: this large, round-conical apple has a skin that is primarily golden-yellow with a distinct orange-red blush, often covered in fine russeting, especially near the stem. its surface can feel slightly rough or sandy. it is notably larger than the small variety of the same type.

items.name: Reine des Reinettes Apples - Small
items.desc: this small, round-conical apple has a skin that is primarily golden-yellow with a distinct orange-red blush, often covered in fine russeting, especially near the stem. its surface can feel slightly rough or sandy. it is notably smaller than the large variety of the same type.

items.name: Rhubarb - Bunch
items.desc: rhubarb consists of long, thick, celery-like stalks that are typically bright red, pink, or sometimes greenish. the stalks are firm and fibrous, with a smooth, slightly glossy surface. they are usually sold in bunches, trimmed of their toxic leaves, and can range from 30 to 60 cm in length. the internal flesh is pale green to pink.

items.name: Rhubarb - Regular
items.desc: long, thick, fibrous stalks resembling celery, but wider and often flattened. colors range from deep red to pink to light green, with redder stalks often indicating higher sweetness. the texture is firm and stringy, with a distinctly tart aroma.

items.name: Ripe Avocados
items.desc: this avocado is characterized by its dark, almost black, pebbly skin which yields slightly to gentle pressure when ripe. its shape is typically pear-like or oval. the dark, rough texture distinguishes it from firmer, greener, unripe avocados.

items.name: Riverbelle Apples
items.desc: riverbelle apples are medium-sized, round to slightly conical, with a striking bright pink-red blush and distinct red stripes over a pale yellow or cream base. their skin is smooth and often has a slightly waxy appearance. the shape is uniformly round with a small stem.

items.name: Roma Tomatoes
items.desc: showing elongated plum-oval shape, bright red, meaty, fewer seeds

items.name: Roma Tomatoes - On the Vine
items.desc: these are medium-sized, elongated oval or plum-shaped tomatoes attached to a green vine or truss, typically in clusters. they have smooth, firm, glossy, bright red skin and denser, less watery flesh compared to round tomatoes, ideal for sauces and cooking.

items.name: Roma Tomatoes on the Vine
items.desc: showing elongated plum-oval shape, bright red, meaty, fewer seeds

items.name: Romaine Lettuce
items.desc: a head of romaine (cos) lettuce — an elongated upright head of leafy green leaves, about 10-12 inches tall. broad, crisp, dark green outer leaves wrap around a pale green-white compact center. thick white central ribs run up each leaf. clearly a leafy green vegetable, not a tomato or any round fruit.

items.name: Rome Apples, Large (East/Central)
items.desc: showing solid bright red, very round and smooth, thick skin, greenish dimple at stem

items.name: Rome Apples, Large (West)
items.desc: large-sized, firm, and nearly uniformly deep red apple, often with a slight blush of green visible near the stem or base. it typically has a round to somewhat flattened shape with a smooth, thick skin and can exhibit prominent lenticels.

items.name: Round Zucchini/Courgette Squash
items.desc: this squash is characterized by its perfectly spherical or slightly flattened round shape, resembling a small green ball. the skin is smooth, glossy, and ranges from dark green to medium green, sometimes with faint lighter speckles or stripes. it typically measures 5-10 cm in diameter and has firm, pale green to white flesh, similar in taste and texture to standard elongated zucchini.

items.name: Royal Mandarin
items.desc: a medium-sized citrus fruit, generally larger than typical tangerines, with bright orange, moderately easy-to-peel skin that can appear slightly lumpy or bumpy. it has a rich, sweet, and juicy flavor, often with a somewhat flattened or round shape. it might be mistaken for a small orange.

items.name: Rubinette Apples
items.desc: these are small to medium, often irregular-shaped apples. the skin exhibits a beautiful mottled orange-red over a yellow background, frequently adorned with distinctive russet dots and patches, particularly near the stem. the flesh is very crisp, juicy, and intensely sweet-tart with a complex aromatic flavor.

items.name: RubyFrost Apple
items.desc: rubyfrost apples are medium-sized and distinctly round. their skin is a deep, rich ruby-red color, often with some subtle striations over a green base, giving it a polished appearance. the skin is firm and thin, enclosing bright white, exceptionally crisp and tart-sweet flesh.

items.name: Russet Apples
items.desc: russet apples are medium-sized, round to conical fruits, uniquely defined by their rough, sandpaper-like, brownish-gold or bronze russeted skin that covers most or all of the apple, sometimes with a faint underlying green or red hue. the flesh is crisp, yellowish, and nutty-sweet, often described as having a pear-like texture.

items.name: Russet Potatoes
items.desc: showing brown rough netted skin, oblong oval shape, classic baking potato

items.name: Rutabaga
items.desc: showing large round globe, tan-yellow skin with purple crown, often wax-coated

items.name: Sable Seedless® Grapes
items.desc: sable seedless® grapes are medium-sized, oval-shaped berries with a deep purple-black skin that often has a powdery bloom, making them appear dusky. they are characterized by their consistently uniform size and firm, crisp texture. the skin is typically smooth and taut, clinging to the flesh.

items.name: Sacred Pepper Leaf
items.desc: sacred pepper leaves are large, heart-shaped leaves, typically deep green on the upper surface and paler on the underside. they have a slightly velvety texture and prominent veins that radiate from the base. the leaves are broad and flexible, often growing to palm-sized or larger, with a distinctive aromatic fragrance.

items.name: Saffron Milk-Cap Mushrooms
items.desc: the saffron milk-cap mushroom has an orange to reddish-brown cap, often with concentric rings or spots. its gills and stem, when bruised or cut, exude a distinctive orange to reddish 'milk' or latex. the cap is convex, becoming funnel-shaped with age, and typically 5-15 cm in diameter. its texture is smooth, and the overall appearance is earthy and robust.

items.name: Saffron Sweet Potato
items.desc: saffron sweet potatoes are typically oblong to slightly irregular in shape, with a smooth, relatively thin skin that ranges from a pale to medium orange-tan color. when cut, their flesh is a vibrant, deep orange-yellow, reminiscent of saffron spice. they are firm and dense, often with a tapering end.

items.name: Sage
items.desc: sage leaves are distinctly elongated oval or lance-shaped with a soft, velvety, and slightly fuzzy texture. their color is a muted grayish-green, often appearing almost silvery, and they feature prominent veins across their surface. the leaves grow on firm, woody stems and are typically sold in small bundles.

items.name: Santa Claus Melon
items.desc: this large, oval-shaped melon has a thick, smooth, dark green rind that is often mottled with irregular yellow patches, giving it a unique, somewhat waxy appearance. the interior flesh is pale green to white, very juicy, and distinctly sweet. it is notably recognized for its extended shelf life.

items.name: Sapodillo
items.desc: small to medium-sized fruit, roughly round or oval, with a dull, slightly rough, brown or reddish-brown skin that resembles a potato or kiwi. the flesh inside is grainy, pale yellow to reddish-brown, very sweet, and contains a few hard, black, glossy seeds. it feels soft when ripe.

items.name: Saskatoon Berries
items.desc: showing dark purple-blue, very small round berry, similar to blueberry

items.name: Saticoy Melon
items.desc: the saticoy melon is typically round to slightly oval, often appearing slightly flattened at the top and bottom. it has a vibrant, unnetted, golden-yellow rind that is smooth and firm. the flesh inside is a pale, almost white-green, very juicy, and possesses a sweet taste with a subtle floral aroma.

items.name: Satsuma Mandarins
items.desc: showing light orange color, very loose baggy skin, slightly flattened

items.name: Satsuma Tangerine
items.desc: satsuma tangerines are typically medium-sized, round to slightly flattened, with a vibrant orange, often somewhat pebbly skin that is famously loose and easy to peel. they are known for their sweet, juicy, and typically seedless segments. the fruit often has a slight neck at the stem end and can appear a bit 'puffy'.

items.name: Satsuma Tangerine - Clauselina
items.desc: the clauselina satsuma is a medium-sized, flat-round mandarin, characterized by its deep orange, often slightly bumpy skin that is exceptionally loose and easy to peel. it has a distinctive small neck at the stem end. the fruit is notably juicy and sweet with very few seeds, if any, and its flesh is tender.

items.name: Savory
items.desc: savory is an herb with small, narrow, pointed leaves growing along thin, delicate stems. its color ranges from a vibrant light green (summer savory) to a darker, more muted green (winter savory), similar in texture to thyme but softer. it is typically sold in small bunches, emitting a peppery, aromatic scent.

items.name: Savoy Cabbage - Green
items.desc: savoy cabbage is easily distinguished by its crinkled, deeply textured, dark green leaves that form a loose, rounded head. unlike smooth varieties, its leaves are bubbly and wavy, offering a more tender texture and a milder flavor. the head is generally less dense and lighter in weight than other common cabbages.

items.name: Scallopini Squash
items.desc: small, disc-shaped summer squash, often light green to yellow, with scalloped edges resembling a flying saucer. it has a smooth, tender skin and a delicate, creamy white flesh.

items.name: Scarlotta Seedless Grapes
items.desc: scarlotta seedless grapes are medium-sized, round to slightly oval, with a vibrant, uniform red skin that can have a slightly dusty bloom. they grow in moderately dense clusters. their bright, consistent red color distinguishes them from darker red or bi-colored grape varieties.

items.name: Sciearly (Pacific Beauty) Apples - Large
items.desc: large, round-conical apples with a vibrant red blush covering a creamy yellow background, often displaying a smooth, waxy skin. they offer a crisp texture and a sweet, slightly tart flavor, making them ideal for fresh eating. this specific variant is larger in size compared to its standard counterpart.

items.name: Sciearly (Pacific Beauty) Apples - Small
items.desc: small, round-conical apples with a vibrant red blush covering a creamy yellow background, often displaying a smooth, waxy skin. they offer a crisp texture and a sweet, slightly tart flavor, making them ideal for fresh eating. this specific variant is smaller in size compared to its standard counterpart.

items.name: Scilate Apples (ENVY) - Large
items.desc: these large, round-conical apples boast a striking, deep ruby-red skin with occasional golden-yellow streaks or speckles, giving them a polished appearance. the skin is smooth and slightly thick. this specific entry refers to the larger size variant of the scilate apple.

items.name: Scired (Pacific Queen) Apples
items.desc: medium-sized, firm, round to slightly conical apples with a striking deep red skin, sometimes showing faint yellow-green undertones or subtle stripes. the flesh is exceptionally crisp, juicy, and sweet with a pleasant aroma. the intense, uniform red coloration is a key distinguishing feature.

items.name: Seckel Pears
items.desc: showing very small pear, olive-green with dark red blush, bite-sized

items.name: Seedless Lemons
items.desc: medium-sized, oval to oblong fruit with a bright, vibrant yellow rind that can be smooth or slightly textured. unlike regular lemons, these are specifically bred to contain no or very few seeds inside their tart, juicy flesh. the skin may be somewhat bumpy.

items.name: Serrano Pepper
items.desc: very small 1-2 inch pepper, thin cylindrical, dark green, pointed tip, smaller than jalapeno

items.name: Shallots
items.desc: showing small elongated shape, coppery-brown papery skin

items.name: Sharlin Melon
items.desc: sharlin melons are elongated, oval-shaped melons with smooth, firm, bright yellow skin that often has subtle green marbling. the flesh inside is pale green to white, very juicy, and sweet, with a small central seed cavity. they are typically medium to large in size.

items.name: Sheep Polypore Mushrooms
items.desc: the sheep polypore mushroom is typically white to cream-colored, with an irregular, wavy cap margin that can be lobed. its underside is porous, not gilled, with very small, densely packed pores. the cap can grow quite large, often 10-25 cm across, and has a firm, meaty texture. it grows in a rosette or clustered fashion, often appearing as a brain-like mass.

items.name: Shell Beans
items.desc: shell beans refer to a variety of fresh beans intended for shelling, meaning the pods are not typically eaten. the pods are robust, often plump and lumpy, varying in length (4-8 inches) and color (green, yellow, or speckled) depending on the specific bean type within. they house mature, distinct beans that are usually firm and brightly colored.

items.name: Shiitake Mushrooms
items.desc: showing tan-brown umbrella-shaped cap, slight curl at edges, white cracking pattern on cap

items.name: Shinano Gold (yello®) Apples
items.desc: a medium-sized, round to slightly conical apple with a smooth, sunny golden-yellow skin, sometimes featuring a very faint reddish blush on sun-exposed areas. it possesses a firm, crisp flesh with a balanced sweet-tart flavor, distinct from green varieties.

items.name: Shiny Red Persimmon
items.desc: medium-sized, firm, round to slightly flattened fruit, reminiscent of a small tomato, with a smooth, glossy, vibrant orange-red skin when ripe. it prominently features a green, leafy calyx at the top, and its flesh is sweet and crisp when firm.

items.name: Skylar Rae Cherries
items.desc: skylar rae cherries are distinctively bi-colored, featuring a vibrant yellow skin with a prominent red blush or marbling, sometimes appearing pinkish-orange. they are small to medium-sized, round to heart-shaped, with firm, glossy skin and a short green stem. their coloration sets them apart from typical dark red cherries.

items.name: SnapDragon Apple
items.desc: snapdragon apples are medium to large in size, with a slightly conical to round shape. their skin is a vibrant, almost uniform dark red, sometimes with faint stripes over a yellow-green background. the skin is typically smooth and firm, covering very crisp and juicy cream-colored flesh.

items.name: Snow Peas
items.desc: flat, bright green, broad pods with a crisp texture, containing very small, undeveloped peas inside. the edges of the pods may have a delicate string. they are typically sold loose or in bags and maintain a consistent appearance regardless of individual pod length.

items.name: Sonya Apples - Large
items.desc: these large, conical to round apples display a vibrant red blush over a yellow-green base, frequently showing delicate cream-colored lenticels. they possess a smooth, thin skin. this is the larger size variant of sonya apples.

items.name: Sonya Apples - Small
items.desc: these small, conical to round apples have a vibrant red blush over a yellow-green background, often with subtle cream-colored lenticels. their skin is smooth and relatively thin. this is the smaller size variant of sonya apples.

items.name: Sorrel
items.desc: sorrel leaves are a vibrant, bright green, often characterized by an arrowhead or spear-like shape. they possess a smooth and somewhat succulent texture, growing in a rosette form from the base. the leaves range from small to medium in size and are typically sold in loose bunches.

items.name: Soursop
items.desc: soursop is a large, ovate to heart-shaped tropical fruit, typically green with a spiky, slightly bumpy texture on its skin. it can weigh several pounds, ranging from 1 to 5 lbs. the flesh is white, fibrous, and juicy, encasing numerous black, inedible seeds, and has a unique sweet-tart flavor.

items.name: Southern Snap Apples
items.desc: medium-sized apple, exhibiting a vibrant, mostly red skin often streaked or blushed with yellow-green, especially towards the bottom. it has a crisp, firm texture, a somewhat conical shape, and a smooth, moderately thick skin.

items.name: Spaghetti Squash
items.desc: showing oval oblong shape, bright yellow smooth hard shell

items.name: Spanish Tendral Melon
items.desc: spanish tendral melons are characterized by their deeply ridged, dark green to black-green skin, which can appear rough and waxy. they are typically elongated-oval in shape, often tapering at the ends. the flesh is bright white, very sweet, and firm, containing small, dark seeds.

items.name: Sprite Melon
items.desc: a small, round to slightly oval melon with a very thin, smooth, pale yellow-white rind, occasionally showing faint green striping. the flesh is crisp, exceptionally sweet, and typically white to very pale green, enclosing a compact central seed cavity. its diminutive size and delicate skin are key visual identifiers.

items.name: Squash - Acorn - Golden
items.desc: a medium-sized winter squash, distinctive for its ridged, acorn-like shape, tapering to a point at one end. the skin is a vibrant, uniform golden-yellow color, smooth yet firm, with prominent longitudinal ridges running from stem to blossom end. the flesh inside is orange-yellow and sweet when cooked.

items.name: Squash - Acorn - Swan White Table Queen

items.name: Stripy Bell Peppers (Enjoya™)

items.name: Sturmer Pippin Apples

items.name: Sugar Apple

items.name: Sugar Cane
items.desc: long, thick, cylindrical stalk, typically green to purplish-red in color, with distinct nodes or joints along its length. the exterior is hard and fibrous, while the interior contains a sweet, juicy pulp. it often measures several feet in length when whole, but is usually sold in shorter segments.

items.name: Sugar Snap Peas
items.desc: crunchy, edible pods with a distinctive rounded, plump shape, appearing like swollen green pea pods. they are bright green, glossy, and typically have a small 'string' along the seam that can be removed. the peas inside are well-formed but the pod itself is eaten.

items.name: SugarBee Apples - Small
items.desc: small sugarbee apples are characteristically round to conical, featuring a brilliant reddish-orange blush over a pale yellow or cream background, often with distinct yellow speckles. their skin is smooth and glossy. these are noticeably smaller than standard sugarbee apples.

items.name: SugraFiftyFour Novelty Seedless Grapes
items.desc: sugrafiftyfour grapes are a unique novelty variety, often exhibiting an elongated or tapering oval shape and a striking color combination, potentially red and green marbling or a distinct blush. their size can vary from medium to large, and they possess a firm, juicy flesh. the 'novelty' aspect suggests an unusual visual characteristic compared to standard grapes.

items.name: SugraFiftySix Green Seedless Grapes

items.name: SugraFiftyThree Red Seedless Grapes

items.name: Sugrafortynine Black Seedless Grapes
items.desc: these are medium-sized, plump black seedless grapes with a deep, almost purple-black skin. the skin is typically smooth and can have a slight natural waxy bloom. their shape is generally round to slightly oval, distinguishing them from longer varieties.

items.name: Sunchokes (Jerusalem Artichokes)

items.name: Sunions® Tearless Sweet Onions

items.name: Sunny Gold™ Yellow Mini Seedless Watermelon - 3-7 LBS

items.name: Sweet Potato - Small

items.name: Sweet Potato/Yam/Kumara - Red/Orangy Red Flesh - Large

items.name: Sweet Potatoes (Yam)

items.name: Sweet Potatoes, White

items.name: Sweet Red Italian Onions - Flat

items.name: Sweet Sensation Pears
items.desc: medium-sized pear with a classic pear shape, wider at the bottom and tapering towards the stem. its skin is a striking bright red blush over a yellow-green base, often with small, pale russet dots. the surface is smooth and the stem is typically medium length.

items.name: Sweetheart Tearless Red Onions

items.name: Swiss Gourmet Apples - Small

items.name: Tamarind

items.name: Tangelo

items.name: Tangelo - Jamaican (Ugli®)
